hotels.name: Sofitel Le Scribe Paris Opéra
hotels.description: Sofitel Le Scribe Paris Opéra, a 5* hotel near Palais Garnier, is legendary in the district. Designed by Tristan Auer, it blends the heritage of a historic hotel with the intimacy of a Haussmannian apartment. For business or a romantic stay, relax in your elegant room with a view of the Eiffel Tower. Savor French excellence, from an invigorating Parisian breakfast to a rejuvenating massage at the spa.

hotels.name: Boutet Bastille Hotel Paris - MGallery Collection
hotels.description: In the heart of the 11th arrondissement and near Bastille, this hotel is located in a historic setting: Maison Boutet. First a lumber factory and later a chocolaterie, the building has kept its old charm. Unusual and unique, our hotel has 80 rooms and suites (8 with a terrace). Unwind at the Spa with a pool, sauna, hammam and fitness center. Bar snack service. Hotel parking: EUR 45. Pets welcome: EUR 25.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Pigalle Sacre Coeur
hotels.description: The 4-star Mercure Paris Pigalle Sacre Coeur is a friendly and tranquil oasis in Pigalle. An upscale location in a renewal area, it celebrates the local art scene through its bright bedrooms. Fling your shutters wide each morning on the Sacre Coeur or the Paris rooftops. Book your bedroom with a view, and enjoy the room service. Sunbathe right in the hotel, on the veranda and terrace.

hotels.name: Hotel L'Échiquier Opéra Paris - MGallery Collection
hotels.description: The 4-star hotel L'Echiquier Opéra Paris in central Paris is near the Grands Boulevards and the Opera, hub of French culture and lifestyle with its theaters and shows. The refurbished hotel blends modernity and Art Nouveau, preserving a Belle Epoque heritage of cabinet-making, mosaic floors, and paintings. The modern rooms and suites reflect the unique style of a Parisian apartment.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Tolbiac Bibliotheque
hotels.description: Enjoy a warm welcome at our hotel in Paris 13th arrondissement. You will feel right at home in the comfort of our spacious rooms. With quality bedding, double-glazed double windows and a bathroom with tub, the rooms can accommodate 1-4 people. In our especially charming ibis Styles, you can read a book from the lobby library - a nod to the nearby BnF - have a drink at the bar or order a snack at any time.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Cadet Lafayette
hotels.description: The ibis Styles Paris Cadet Lafayette is close to Montmartre, the Grands Boulevards and Opéra. Stroll through the nearby Moulin Rouge, Sacré-Coeur and Paris's covered passageways. Book a stay at one of our 46 rooms on a beautiful Parisian street and enjoy a friendly welcome from our team and generous complimentary breakfast. Guests can work, relax and discover our featured artists in our lobby area.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris La Sorbonne Saint Germain des Prés Hotel
hotels.description: Fully renovated, Mercure La Sorbonne Saint-Germain-des-Pres is on the border of the 5th and 6th arrondissements, opposite Sorbonne University, on the edge of the Latin Quarter and St-Germain-des-Pres. Easy to access via RER B and metro Saint-Michel, Cluny-La Sorbonne,. 4 star boutique hotel with modern decor, ideal for business or leisure stays. Rest in our quiet, comfy rooms with AC. Bar with courtyard.

hotels.name: Sofitel Paris Arc de Triomphe
hotels.description: In the heart of the 8th arrondissement near the vibrant Champs-Elysées, our 5-star hotel seduces epicurean travelers who wish to enjoy Parisian life to the full. Admire Paris from the roof of the Arc de Triomphe, attend theater shows, discover great museums. Our luxury hotel is also at the center of Paris fashion, between the boutiques on the Champs-Elysées and the luxury brands of Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

hotels.name: Sofitel Paris le Faubourg
hotels.description: Between the very elegant Faubourg Saint-Honoré, the mythical avenue des Champs-Elysées and the prestigious Place de la Concorde, experience a 5-star spot with Parisian chic. The decoration by Didier Gomez reinterprets the codes of haute couture. The refinement of the rooms, the elegance of the suites with the appearance of apartments, the gourmet spots, the attention paid to the reception and service will help you discover a collection of magnificent experiences.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Centre Bercy
hotels.description: Across from the Accor Arena and next to Bercy Park, Novotel Paris Centre Bercy welcomes you with a friendly atmosphere. Completely redesigned, our hotel offers modern and comfortable rooms that meet all your needs. Our seven sunlit meeting rooms provide modular, tech-enabled spaces for your events. Le Paris Bercy restaurant invites you to enjoy bistro-style dishes in its bright and spacious dining room. Take your time! Sharing platters and cocktails await you at the Bar.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Bercy Bibliothèque Hotel
hotels.description: Welcome to Mercure Paris Bercy Bibliotheque, combining comfort and intimacy in a literature-inspired decor. Near Accor Arena, Arena Bercy, stroll along the quays and soak up the Parisian ambiance. Ever dreamed of napping by the Seine? Whether here on business or with family, enjoy moments of relaxation and discovery. Our bar and restaurant La Page and its team welcome you daily for a literary getaway.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Bastille Faubourg Saint Antoine 11th
hotels.description: Ibis Paris Bastille Faubourg Saint Antoine in the heart of Paris invites you to discover the city charm. Near Gare de Lyon and Place de la Bastille, our central location is ideal for visiting the sights in the capital. Immerse yourself in the tranquility of our garden with terrace, a green oasis in the heart of Paris. This idyllic setting is perfect for enjoying our cocktails on summer evenings.

hotels.name: SO/ PARIS Hotel
hotels.description: SO/ Paris, discreetly positioned between Le Marais and Île Saint-Louis, presents a modern expression of Parisian luxury shaped by fashion, design, and cultural influence. Set above the Seine, the hotel reveals expansive views across the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, and the historic skyline, offering a refined perspective on the city. This distinctive address attracts a global clientele seeking elegance, privacy, and a curated lifestyle experience in one of Paris's most desirable neighborhoods.

hotels.name: Hotel Maison Hamelin Paris - Handwritten Collection
hotels.description: Surrounded by chic Haussmannian buildings, the 4-star Maison Hamelin Paris exudes French excellence. Enjoy a unique and refined experience with a view of the Eiffel Tower, near the upscale Golden Triangle district. In a district renowned for fashion, our 65 rooms, designed like fitting rooms, reflect our attention to detail. Start the day with a homemade breakfast with French produce at Le Atelier.

hotels.name: Ibis Styles Paris Gare De Lyon Bastille
hotels.description: Experience the cozy world of the printing press with Johannes Gutenberg as your host. A true living space for staying, connecting and working, the ibis Styles Paris Gare de Lyon Bastille is a unique hotel inspired by the history of printing. All of our 49 rooms are equipped with air conditioning in summer and heating in winter, as well as free fiber-optic WiFi.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris 16 Boulogne
hotels.description: The ibis Styles Paris 16 Boulogne hotel is ideally located near Porte de Saint-Cloud metro station, in the heart of the Boulogne, Issy-les-Moulineaux and Paris 16 business districts. The entire hotel was created in 2017 in an elegant and friendly style. T here is a coworking space, 16 and Co, in the hotel lobby, designed with you in mind. Close to Rolland Garros, the Eiffel Tower and the Champs Elysees, the hotel is ideally located for your appointments in Paris.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Nation
hotels.description: Adagio Paris Nation, in the Picpus area of the 12th district, is ideal for a family weekend or business stay. Near Daumesnil metro station, visit Paris' landmarks or stroll along the leafy Coulée Verte. Studios and apartments with kitchen offer comfort and flexibility. Also enjoy relaxing on our welcoming terrace. An environment combining practicality and serenity for an authentic Parisian experience.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Avenue de la Republique
hotels.description: In a charming building, our hotel in Paris Republique combines the cachet of the old and contemporary comfort. In a completely renovated space, stone walls and exposed beams add extra soul. Each room is a cozy and warm nest, some with a view of Paris rooftops or Place de la Republique. We look at attend to every need and provide a friendly atmosphere.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Opera Grands Boulevards Hotel
hotels.description: Discover the elegance and magic of jazz in the heart of Paris by staying at Mercure Paris Opéra Grands Boulevards. This boutique hotel has 50 renovated rooms and 2 fully equipped duplex apartments, offering comfort for all types of stay. Enjoy the Paris vibe on the dynamic Grands Boulevards with theaters and cabarets. Enjoy a show at Grand Rex and Folies Bergères or a shopping spree at Galeries Lafayette.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Notre Dame Saint Germain des Prés
hotels.description: Stay a 8-min walk from Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral, Île de la Cité and Île Saint-Louis, opposite the Sorbonne. In the heart of the Latin Quarter, Mercure Paris Notre-Dame Saint-Germain-des-Prés is in a great location. Easy access by RER B, RER C and Saint-Michel and Cluny-La Sorbonne metro stations. Come and relax in comfortable bedrooms with A/C and a contemporary decor.

hotels.name: Ibis Styles Paris Buttes-Chaumont
hotels.description: One minute from Laumière metro station, the ibis Styles Paris Buttes-Chaumont offers a vibrant, comfortable stay in a quiet and lively area. Free WiFi and a friendly atmosphere with breakfast included. Our hotel is close to Parc des Buttes-Chaumont, Canal de l'Ourcq, the Zénith, Stade de France and Villepinte. An ideal, cost-effective base for guests attending concerts or corporate events.

hotels.name: Novotel Suites Paris Expo Porte de Versailles
hotels.description: A modern hotel with a sleek decor, the Novotel Suites Paris Expo Porte de Versailles offers 323 sq. ft. suites for weekend getaways as a couple or family, ideally situated in the heart of the capital. To help you make the most of your stay, our hotel features a fitness center, a virtual concierge service, a co-working space and a 24-hour Boutique Gourmande for when you get peckish.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Philippe Auguste
hotels.description: The Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Philippe Auguste is located just a short walk away from Père Lachaise in Paris 20th arrondissement. Its 35 functional and fully-equipped apartments range from studios to 2-room apartments and the Aparthotel also boasts a charming,  leafy patio. There is a metro station less than 109 yds, 100 m away. Discover this dynamic neighborhood with its art galleries, concert halls and stores, all located on a calm and peaceful road.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Bastille Marais hotel
hotels.description: You will love the baroque and contemporary look of this hotel. It is ideally located close to metro Voltaire for quick access under 30 min to the capitals hot spots and trendy districts such as the Marais, Bastille and Republique. This hotel offers large  Privilege Rooms with views of the Sacre Coeur and rooftops of Paris. The refined and inviting design ensures maximum comfort during your stay. An ideal place for you to organize a business trip or romantic weekend away.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare de Lyon Ledru Rollin 12th
hotels.description: After a long day of sightseeing or work, join us for a rejuvenating break. In the heart of Paris, ibis Gare de Lyon Ledru Rollin welcomes you to its 119 rooms with air conditioning, Sweet Bed bedding and free fiber WIFI. Discover our triple and communicating rooms for family stays. Our private garden welcomes you throughout the seasons for breakfast, an aperitif, a concert or a dose of vitamin D!

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Gare de Lyon
hotels.description: The Novotel Paris Gare de Lyon hotel welcomes you for a stay with family or for business. Enjoy a peaceful break thanks to our hotel with pool in the heart of Paris, in a dynamic district close to Gare de Lyon, Place de la Bastille and the Marais. For those who like to work out, head to our fitness center or the banks of the Seine for a jog. Kids will enjoy our childrens play area, while parents can relax at the Mediterranean-inspired Olicea bar and restaurant.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Tolbiac 13th
hotels.description: Quick links to the main tourist areas in Paris from nearby Tolbiac Metro station and via Metro lines 5, 6 and 7 from Place d'Italie. The ibis Paris Italie Tolbiac hotel is close to the Gare de Lyon, Gare d'Austerlitz and Gare Montparnasse train stations. To get to Orly Airport, catch the Orlybus, just a few minutes' walk from the hotel. The hotel boasts 60 fully renovated and air-conditioned rooms, including 21 triple rooms. Free WIFI, 24-hour bar and snack service, covered car park (charges apply).

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Butte Montmartre Basilique
hotels.description: Welcome to Mercure PARIS BUTTE MONTMARTRE BASILICA in the dynamic 18th arrondissement of Paris. Nestled in the heart of the City of Light, our hotel is the perfect base for discovering the city. Our hotel with Parisian charm offers an unforgettable experience. Elegantly decorated rooms are designed for your well being, equipped with everything you need for a pleasant business or leisure stay.

hotels.name: Hotel Mercure Paris 17 Batignolles
hotels.description: In the 17th arrondissement, Mercure Paris 17 Batignolles is the ideal base for an unforgettable stay in the capital. 134 comfortable bedrooms offer a restful sleep, some with balcony and a view of the rooftops of Paris and the Eiffel Tower. Relax at the hotel's Bar à Bourgogne or on the courtyard. Whether with family, friends or for business, you'll love the chic modern decor. Green Key certified hotel.

hotels.name: Hotel Faubourg Galant Paris, Handwritten Collection
hotels.description: Located in Paris, in the lively Faubourg Montmartre district in the 9th arrondissement, our hotel invites you to experience a refined interlude, between Parisian elegance and contemporary design. Every detail has been carefully thought out and every space offers calm. We have 63 rooms available in the categories double, twin, triple and suite, all designed to offer a rarity in Paris: a real break.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Opéra Garnier Hotel & Spa
hotels.description: Ideally located between the Opera Garnier, Madeleine church, Saint-Lazare train station and major department stores, the Mercure Paris Opera Garnier Hotel and Spa welcomes you in a chic yet calm atmosphere in the heart of the 8th arrondissement. Discover a haven of comfort and refinement, built around a verdant inner courtyard, graced by an exceptional wall of foliage and punctuated by wooden frames reminiscent of garden pergolas.

hotels.name: Ibis Paris Gare de Lyon Reuilly
hotels.description: Nestled in the heart of the 12th arrondissement of Paris, near Gare de Lyon, the lively Bastille and Nation districts and the Accor Arena, the ibis Paris Gare de Lyon Reuilly hotel and its friendly team welcome you to its 42 air-conditioned and renovated rooms. Our hotel offers modern comfort, with high-speed WIFI as well as private and secure parking. Throughout the seasons, enjoy our courtyard and its green wall - the perfect place to relax after a busy day in the capital.

hotels.name: Too Hotel & Spa Paris - MGallery Collection
hotels.description: In the iconic 13th arrondissement, the TOO Hotel designed by Philippe Starck provides an exceptional experience atop Tour Jean Nouvel. The 139 rooms and suites offer spectacular views of Paris, the Eiffel Tower and Seine, making it an ideal choice for business or leisure stays. Includes a panoramic restaurant, lively skybar and the highest rooftop in Paris, plus an outdoor Jacuzzi and 4 meeting rooms.

hotels.name: Le Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris
hotels.description: Step inside a masterpiece at the heart of the city of light. Poised majestically in the shadow of the Arc De Triomphe Le Royal Monceau is not just a luxury hotel but a legend that has played host to the greats of history. Daringly redesigned by Philippe Starck this Parisian icon is just a stones throw from the worlds most famous avenue the Champs Elysees. We invite you to experience an oasis of refinement and unrivaled service.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Opéra Lafayette
hotels.description: Welcome to the right bank. Chic, popular cinemas theaters cafes and unique hotels for all pockets. The ibis Styles Paris Opéra Lafayette, in the heart of Paris, right next to the Grands Boulevards, is full of good vibes. You will be in awe of its brand new décor, inspired by Sainte-Cécile, the patron saint of musicians. Stay solo or with friends or family in this new spot in the center of the Capital.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Gare de Lyon TGV
hotels.description: With a nod to its ancestral profession, stay in the world of herbalism at ibis Styles Paris Gare de Lyon TGV, opposite the station, right outside the metro. The hotel, ideal for business/leisure stays in the center of Paris, fully renovated in 2021, has 44 air-conditioned bedrooms for up to 4 people. From the hotel, travel all over Paris on metro lines 1, 14 and the RER A, right outside the hotel.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Meteor Avenue d'Italie
hotels.description: City lovers, families, athletes, professionals, there's something for everyone at ibis Styles Paris Météor Avenue d'Italie, open 24/7. Relax in our air-conditioned rooms with Sweet Bed bedding and enjoy a hearty and tasty breakfast to start the day off right. Are you staying with family? Ask about our family rooms or suites for up to six people. Evening food service is available Monday through Friday.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Nation Cours de Vincennes
hotels.description: In Paris's vibrant 12th arrondissement, discover the ibis Styles Paris Nation Cours de Vincennes, featuring modern decor themed around wellness. We make your stay unforgettable, whether traveling solo, with family or friends! In the morning, enjoy our buffet breakfast and, at the end of the day, relax in our courtyard with a peaceful Parisian garden. Our hotel was awarded Green Key 2026 certification!

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Orly Airport
hotels.description: Near Paris-Orly airport, make a stopover at ibis Styles Paris Orly Airport. No clouds on the horizon: put down your suitcases and relax. A free shuttle takes you to Terminals 1, 2, 3 and 4 in five minutes. Early take-off? The unlimited buffet breakfast is served from 5am. Landing late? The TAKE AIR bar and Boutique Gourmande welcome you 24/7. Safely park your car in the car park during your stopover.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare de L'Est 10ème
hotels.description: Welcome to ibis Paris Gare de l'Est 10th! This 44-room hotel is ideal for a solo stay, a getaway for two, or a family break in Paris. Enjoy Chromecast in our rooms, our buffet breakfast and our 3 fully equipped meeting rooms. Relax at the bar, where snacks are available 24/7. Just steps from Gare de l'Est station and Roissy CDG Airport, the hotel is perfectly located for getting around. A paid public car park is nearby for extra convenience.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Porte de Versailles
hotels.description: Steps from major exhibition centers, Novotel Paris Porte de Versailles invites you into the unique world of architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte. On the 8th floor, admire the vibrant capital from our rooftop restaurant in the 15th arrondissement. In Pedzouilles chic barn setting, savor 100 percent French artisanal cuisine with an Eiffel Tower view, or immerse yourself in the offbeat ambiance of our speakeasy bar.
hotels.street: 4 Av De La Porte De La Plaine

hotels.name: Molitor Hotel & Spa Paris - MGallery Collection
hotels.description: In the heart of the 16th arrondissement, Molitor is a unique destination. A Parisian icon, it blends history, dynamism and the art of living with a contemporary energy. This authentic urban resort offers absolute well-being with its two heated pools, the Spa by Clarins and hammam. Open May to September, the rooftop terrace offers Eiffel Tower views and a vibrant social scene in warmer weather.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montmartre
hotels.description: The Adagio Paris Montmartre aparthotel is near Sacre Coeur in Montmartre, an area that is packed with 20th-century Parisian charm as depicted by artists like Manet, Toulouse-Lautrec and Picasso. Our 76 apartments are suitable for all types of stay. However, the apartments do not have AC and are not adapted for PRM. An indoor garden is available via reception, so you can enjoy some open-air reading.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse
hotels.description: Less than a 10-min walk from Halls 2 and 3 of Montparnasse station, Novotel Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse is perfect for a family or business stay in Paris. Our team caters to your needs. Sip a coffee in our coffee shop, taste creative cocktails in our bar and enjoy French specialties in our restaurant. Looking for action? Make use of our meeting facilities, our co-working space or our fitness center.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare de Lyon Diderot 12th
hotels.description: The comfortable rooms at our hotel in Paris Gare de Lyon offer free ultra-fast WiFi and suit solo travellers, groups of friends and families alike. Ideal for business meetings, the hotel has 4 fully equipped meeting rooms, 2 with natural daylight. There is also a bright, pleasant coworking space, plus a bar open all day. Paid public parking is nearby.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Tour Eiffel Pont Mirabeau Hotel
hotels.description: Close to the banks of the Seine, the Mercure Paris Tour Eiffel Pont Mirabeau offers convenient access to the Eiffel Tower and many of the capitals other sights. Unique rooms with a delightful decor and beautiful views of the Seine if you want to take your stay to new heights. An exclusive experience in a quiet setting at the intimate 4-star hotel. Green Key certified for its sustainability approach.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Grands Boulevards Opera 9th
hotels.description: In the heart of the Grands Boulevards and theater district, hotel ibis Paris Grands Boulevards Opera 9th is waiting for you! A 10-min walk from Opéra Garnier & Galeries LaFayette, you'll enjoy this typically Parisian boutique hotel for business/family stays. Come alone, with friends or family, all aircon rooms have "Sweet Bed" bedding, and free Wi-Fi. The Chill#38 is a "must-see", relaxing spot.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon TGV hotel
hotels.description: Right by the train station, the Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon TGV hotel is perfect for business, featuring 5 meeting rooms and a co-working space. Enjoy our fitness center or discover Corner Station: our coffee shop with a terrace. At approximately 183 sq. ft. (17 m²), our rooms offer an optimized, comfortable space designed for relaxation. Recharge with our breakfast buffet and begin your Parisian getaway!

hotels.name: Pullman Paris Centre - Bercy
hotels.description: In the heart of the vibrant Bercy district, the trendy Pullman Paris Centre-Bercy, designed by Tom Dixon, invites you to live every moment to the fullest. Enjoy unique services: a trendy restaurant and bar, an ephemeral terrace, co-working spaces, an art gallery, a wellness area, a private cinema by MK2 and 26 hybrid meeting rooms.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Vaugirard Montparnasse
hotels.description: Novotel Paris Vaugirard Montparnasse is not simply a hotel with an Eiffel Tower view, it is an exquisite venue in the 15th arrondissement of Paris. From cozy coffee shop to sky bar with panoramic view: this 4-star hotel is full of surprises. Warm, loft-style design by Jean-Philippe Nuel. Italian restaurant with cuisine by our Italian Chef. Signature cocktails and drinks created by mixologist Matthias Giroud. Just choose your room.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Eiffel Tower Grenelle Hotel
hotels.description: Thanks to its characteristic design, the Mercure Paris Tour Eiffel Grenelle hotel immerses you in the history of the Pondicherry and Chandernagor trading posts. The lounge bar, patio, fitness room and sauna will ensure you relax after long days discovering Paris. We offer free WiFi, room service and a private car park. For successful seminars, discover our equipped rooms with a view of the Japanese garden

hotels.name: Hotel Mercure Paris 15 Porte de Versailles
hotels.description: Ideal for a business trip or Parisian getaway, Mercure Paris 15 Porte de Versailles welcomes you in the 15th district. A short walk from Porte de Versailles Exhibition Center, the hotel is perfect for trade fairs and events. Enjoy comfortable workspaces and meeting rooms bathed in natural light. Our hotel is appreciated by business travelers and families wishing to discover Paris in complete serenity.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Canal Saint-Martin
hotels.description: Located near Canal St-Martin, ibis Paris Canal St-Martin offers a strategic location in a lively district. Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est train stations are 15 min on foot, with direct connections to Orly and Paris CDG. Several metro lines within 330 yds for access to Notre-Dame, Montmartre, Opera and Louvre. Fully renovated with 50 air-conditioned rooms, free WIFI, bar and snacks 24/7. Parking nearby.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Les Halles
hotels.description: Our restaurant is currently being renovated to enhance your experience. Every detail has been carefully thought through to ensure you enjoy a pleasant stay in a comfortable setting. In the heart of the capital, Novotel Paris Les Halles, a Green Key 2026-certified hotel, welcomes you. With excellent public transport links, it offers a modern, welcoming setting, ideal for a romantic weekend or a family stay. Notre-Dame, La Samaritaine and the Louvre are all within walking distance.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Montparnasse Raspail Hotel
hotels.description: Enjoy a Parisian experience at Mercure Paris Montparnasse Raspail. Close to public transport for greater convenience. Gare Montparnasse is a 10-minute walk through the Gaite district and stores. Lines 6, 4 and 12 are near the hotel for quick access to Gare de Lyon, Gare du Nord or Gare de l Est. Place Denfert-Rochereau and the RER B for access to Orly and Roissy Charles de Gaulle airports.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Pere Lachaise
hotels.description: Welcome to the ibis Paris Père Lachaise, a charming 31-room hotel fully renovated in September 2023 to offer a modern and comfortable stay. Enjoy a friendly atmosphere, attentive service and a generous buffet breakfast. One room is adapted for guests with reduced mobility, and WiFi is available throughout the property. Located in the heart of Paris, our hotel has been Green Key certified since 2026.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Buttes Chaumont
hotels.description: Adagio Paris Buttes Chaumont is near Parc des Buttes Chaumont and minutes from the Canal de l Ourcq. A modern building with a small inner courtyard and 60 apartments from 2-person studios to 3-room apartments for 6 people. A typical Parisian district with many stores and amenities. For added convenience, we have a private undercover car park. The aparthotel does not have PMR apartments or AC.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse
hotels.description: In the 14th arrondissement, Mercure Paris Centre Gare Montparnasse has an unusual history as the former entrance to Bobino theater! Near the biggest stages in the theater capital of the world, book a room with a view of the Eiffel Tower or Montparnasse Tower. Business guests can use our 3 meeting rooms. Before a show, sip a cocktail at the bar and enjoy creative cuisine at our bistronomic restaurant.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare Montparnasse Catalogne
hotels.description: Welcome to ibis Paris Gare Montparnasse.  Less than a 5-min walk from Montparnasse train station, this next-generation ibis hotel offers 146 rooms with AC and WiFi. Near Versailles Exhibition Park and the great sights of Paris, our hotel is ideal for your business and leisure stays. Come and relax during the day in our friendly bar. Private car park upon reservation, electric charging stations.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Place d'Italie Butte aux Cailles
hotels.description: For a unique hotel in Paris, stay at our hotel in Paris 13th. In a nod to this district renowned for its street art, the modern decor and design is inspired by street graffiti. Frescoes on each floor depict Parisian monuments or celebrities. Graphic lines in the bedrooms and food-truck in the entrance set the tone. Enjoy the ibis Styles Butte-aux-Cailles pleasant bar, table football and a children's area.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Place d'Italie Hotel
hotels.description: Located in a quintessential 13th arrondissement neighborhood, the Mercure Paris Place d'Italie immerses you in fashion with chic decor and an exhibition of designer dresses. Featuring 4 family rooms and 9 Privilege rooms, some with views of the Eiffel Tower, our hotel also offers a meeting room. Furthermore, it promises delicious breakfasts showcasing regional products sourced from a small local market.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Porte de Versailles - Mairie d'Issy
hotels.description: Discover the ibis Styles Paris Porte de Versailles - Mairie d'Issy, a hotel inspired by the soundscape of Issy-les-Moulineaux. Bright spaces, natural textures and warm tones create a cozy setting. The bar welcomes guests all day, perfect for work or meetups. Complimentary breakfast on the veranda. Unlimited WiFi, family rooms and Sweet Bed bedding make this a great choice for business or family trips.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Montmartre Batignolles
hotels.description: Stroll through the streets of Montmartre, stay at ibis Styles Paris Montmartre Batignolles, with its modern, warm design. Bright spaces with raw materials and warm colors. From the lobby to the rooms, it reflects Montmartre's bohemian spirit, with lively cafés, artists' studios and moments of calm. Breakfast incl., unltd WIFI and a prime location make it a must-visit destination in Paris' 18th district.

hotels.name: Maison Delano Paris
hotels.description: An exclusive hotel in Paris 8th, in an 18th-century building, Maison Delano Paris embodies the spirit of the iconic Delano Miami. With 56 rooms and suites, it cultivates a discreet, refined way of life in the heart of Paris. A vibrant social hub, Delano Café and its patio invite guests to a Mediterranean escape during the day, while Delano Bar is a lively, elegant place to share cocktails and tapas.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris 20 Belleville
hotels.description: The chic, urban-style Novotel Paris 20 Belleville is located near Couronnes metro station in eastern Paris. It is ideal for a family stay, a business trip or a visit to the French capital. We offer double and family rooms for up to 4 people, some with balconies and rooftop views. Enjoy our buffet breakfast, our coffee shop with a co-working space and our 24-hour fitness center.

hotels.name: Mama Shelter Paris West
hotels.description: Mama Shelter Paris West combines bold design, comfort and warmth. Its 207 rooms designed by Dion & Arles offer a home away from home, while the 4,900 sq.ft. restaurant and rooftop invite you to share joyful moments in a festive and welcoming atmosphere. Pet-friendly and Green Key certified, Mama West welcomes families and children with tailored menus and complimentary baby cribs.
hotels.street: 20 Av. de la Porte de la Plaine

hotels.name: Ibis Styles Paris Gare Saint Lazare
hotels.description: Our elegant Haussmannian hotel in Paris Saint-Lazare is ideal for business or leisure trips, with friends or family. In an atmosphere inspired by fashion in the capital of chic and elegance, our modern and soundproofed bedrooms offer comfort and functionality. As a family, book one of our communicating rooms. Thread your way from your soothing bedroom to the haute couture-inspired breakfast area.

hotels.name: Mama Shelter Paris East
hotels.description: Mama Shelter Paris East is more than a hotel: it's a vibrant hub in the heart of the city. Designed by Philippe Starck, Mama captivates with its bold style and welcoming ambience. Savor generous dishes, enjoy cocktails at the bar and relax on the rooftop before retreating to your room offering absolute comfort. Pet-friendly, eco-certified and Green Key certified, Mama takes care of the whole family.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Massena Olympiades
hotels.description: Breakfast and WiFi are included in all hotel rates. In Paris's 13th arrondissement, between the National Library and business district, our hotel is 330 yards from Porte d'Ivry metro station (line 7) and 550 yards from Olympiades metro station (line 14). Stay in our spacious rooms with AC, smart TVs, bathrooms, hairdryers and safes. The fitness center is also open daily from 6am to 10pm. See you soon!

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Reuilly Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Reuilly boasts a fantastic location in the heart of Paris, a stone throw from Place de la Bastille and a few minutes from the Gare de Lyon, making it perfect for business and leisure trips. The smart and practical apartments each  have a kitchen, bathroom and work area with Internet access. Explore the bustling Bastille district with its shopping arcades, restaurants and bars while benefiting from a calm and peaceful location.

hotels.name: Pullman Paris Montparnasse
hotels.description: The flagship Pullman Paris Montparnasse is the city's unmissable hotel for business & leisure stays. With 32 floors, incl. 3 for events/meetings, & bedrooms with panoramic views, this 4* hotel will become your favorite place to stay. 3 new exclusive dining concepts: Fi'lia, rich Italian cuisine, Skybar Paris rooftop with superb view of the city and Umami for your breakfasts and unlimited weekend brunches.

hotels.name: ibis Daumesnil Porte Doree
hotels.description: The ibis Daumesnil Porte Dorée lies in the east of Paris, just a stone's throw from Espace Charenton and Bois de Vincennes, 0.6 miles (1 km) from Lac Daumesnil and 1.9 miles (3 km) from Parc Floral. For leisure, visit the Hippodrome de Vincennes, the Chât eau de Vincennes, the Cité Nationale de l'Histoire de l'Immigration and the AccorHotels Arena for sports events and concerts. 12.4 miles (20 km) from Orly airport and near to Gare de Lyon and Gare de Bercy train stations. Enclosed paying public car park.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris 17
hotels.description: The Novotel Paris 17 welcomes guests to Paris's 17th arrondissement, close to the So Ouest shopping mall. With spacious and executive rooms with views of the Eiffel Tower, our Parisian hotel is an authentic living space where you'll feel right at home. Relax while the kids have fun in our play areas, then enjoy a mouth-watering moment at the hotel's bar and restaurant: perfect for couples and families!

hotels.name: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel
hotels.description: Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel is between the Eiffel Tower and the Champs-Elysées, in the heart of the 16th arrondissement. This beautiful building was transformed into a luxury hotel in the 1920s and was named after its first and famous guest, Lord Baltimore. With its elegant, refined decor and cozy atmosphere, Sofitel Paris Baltimore Tour Eiffel invites you to enjoy the French art of living.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Gare de l'Est TGV
hotels.description: The ibis Styles Paris Gare de l'Est TGV welcomes you to a warm and family-friendly atmosphere with a very British touch. Ideally located opposite the Gare de l'Est and only a 10-minute walk from the Gare du Nord, the hotel is a perfect starting point for exploring the capital. Just a few steps away, let yourself be charmed by the lively atmosphere of the Canal Saint-Martin, its cafés and waterfront promenades.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare de l'Est TGV
hotels.description: Welcome to ibis Paris Gare de l’Est TGV! A budget hotel in Paris, ideal for solo travelers, couples or families. Enjoy our cosy rooms with Chromecast and our 3 meeting rooms. Start the day with a buffet breakfast, then relax at the bar, where snacks are available 24/7. With easy access to the A1 motorway and Roissy CDG Airport, the hotel is close to Gare de l’Est and Gare du Nord. Paid public parking is nearby.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Brancion Parc des Expositions 15eme
hotels.description: In the 15th arr., near Paris Convention Center, Exhibition Center, Paris Dome former Sports Center Porte de Versailles but also main Parisian attractions such as the Eiffel Tower, the Champs Elysees or Montmartre, the Louvre and Orsay museums; the hotel welcomes you 24 hours  to a strategic address. On foot, by tram or by Subway, the capital is here for you.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare Montparnasse 15th
hotels.description: A 1-minute walk from Montparnasse SNCF train station, ibis Paris Gare Montparnasse is ideal for business or leisure stays. Enjoy direct access to major events and tourist sites such as Parc des Expositions (Porte de Versailles), Eiffel Tower and Champs-Élysées. Our 31 rooms feature A/C, Sweet Bed bedding and WIFI. The breakfast room was renovated in 2024. Bar and snack service is available 24 hours a day.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris 14 Porte d'Orléans
hotels.description: Novotel Paris 14 invites you to enjoy great views of Paris from its Executive Rooms and Suites. The rooms are completely soundproofed and feature upscale bedding for a great night's sleep as well as a panoramic photo of the rooftops of Paris. The hotel has five meeting rooms and a mezzanine workspace. You can also relax in the bar lounge, restaurant and fitness center.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Bercy Village 12th
hotels.description: Experience the vibrant atmosphere of a unique neighborhood at the ibis Paris Bercy Village 12ème! Our entire team awaits you for a musically enriching experience in this Green Key-certified hotel. Looking for a comfortable stay in Paris? Need space to work as a team? Seeking new culinary experiences? Discover our 3-star hotel's bright and modern rooms, flexible meeting rooms and our new Kiosk concept!

hotels.name: ibis Paris Bastille Opera 11th
hotels.description: In the 11th arrondissement, ibis Paris Bastille Opéra welcomes you in a trendy, leafy setting. After exploring the Marais, relax with a drink on the terrace or in one of our 305 rooms with a modern design. Our gourmet bistro restaurant offers homemade cuisine with aromatic herbs from our kitchen garden. Here on business? Discover our shared workspace and our bright meeting rooms in the Bastille district.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Montmartre Sacré-Coeur Hotel
hotels.description: Centrally located next to Place de Clichy and its metro lines, South Pi district and its famous cabarets, the Mercure Paris Montmartre Sacre-Coeur hotel is ideal for an authentic Parisian experience. Wander the renowned artistic Montmartre and Place du Tertre to see how artists capture the true essence of Paris. Discover the Grands Magasins, Haussmann-Saint-Lazare-Opera square and the Stade de France.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Étoile Hotel
hotels.description: Located in the Ternes district, Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Etoile ensures a relaxing stay, 0.3 miles from the Arc de Triomphe. Fully renovated, our Paris hotel offers refined rooms and 2 junior suites with terrace. Enjoy local produce at the buffet breakfast and a Boutique Gourmande for snacks. Room service also available. Discover our library space to relax between visits. Use our co-working space.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Batignolles
hotels.description: Ibis Styles Paris Batignolles, renovated in 2022, is located in the lively Batignolles district near Montmartre and its sights: the Moulin Rouge, the basilica dominating the city and the painters' village. A calm, modern and lush green setting, perfect for relaxation. Its elegant design and comfortable amenities ensure a pleasant stay. Enjoy its friendly atmosphere and ideal location for exploring Paris.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare du Nord TGV
hotels.description: Discover the modern and inviting space of the ibis Paris Gare du Nord TGV hotel. Set in a Haussmann building, its 49 renovated and air-conditioned rooms are equipped with Sweet Bed bedding. Some have a balcony, and others offer views of Parisian rooftops. Our triple family rooms and delicious breakfasts create the ideal formula to host you and your children. On a business trip? Enjoy unlimited free WiFi.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Maine Montparnasse
hotels.description: Welcome to our 3-star hotel in Paris 14th district, 0.75 miles from Montparnasse train station and near the tram for quick access to Porte de Versailles, one of the largest exhibition centers in Paris. Denfert-Rochereau is 2 stops away for easy access to Orly and Charles-de-Gaulle airports. To start the day off right, breakfast is included and served in our old, charmingly renovated coal cellar.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris 15 Lecourbe
hotels.description: Near Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, ibis Styles Paris 15 Lecourbe is an intimate hotel with 49 rooms blending comfort, functionality and calm. Air conditioned, bright and carefully furnished, they feature quality bedding, free WIFI and a space for relaxation. With group accommodation for up to 25 people, the hotel caters to the needs of business travelers, families, friends and small groups.

hotels.name: 25hours Hotel Paris Terminus Nord
hotels.description: Located opposite Gare du Nord, 25hours Hotel Paris Terminus Nord is a vibrant tribute to one of Paris’s most multicultural neighborhoods. Inspired by local characters and stories, the interiors feature colorful street art and bold creative touches. The peaceful guest rooms draw inspiration from Africa and Asia, offering a calm retreat from the city's bustle. At the heart of the hotel, NENI restaurant and the Sape Bar bring people together over food, drinks and conversation.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Vaugirard Porte de Versailles
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Vaugirard Porte de Versailles hotel is located next to Convention metro station, five minutes' walk from the exhibition center in a pretty and lively area. Whether on a business trip or vacation, you can take metro line 12 or bus 80 to begi n your journey of discovery in the City of Light: the Eiffel Tower, Opéra and museums. On a small quiet street near a public car park, the hotel boasts 48 air-conditioned rooms, a lovely tree-lined terrace and a team at your disposal 24 hours a day!

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Gare de l'Est Magenta
hotels.description: The decor at ibis Styles Paris Gare de l'Est Magenta is inspired by tattoo art, creating an original atmosphere where every detail expresses character. Our passionate teams are pleased to welcome you and ensure a comfortable stay. Start your day with a delicious, varied buffet breakfast (included), before making the most of your day. The hotel is the perfect starting point for discovering Paris!

hotels.name: ibis Paris Avenue d'Italie 13th
hotels.description: Ideal for a leisure or business stay, our hotel near the Place d'Italie has air-conditioned bedrooms equipped with free WiFi, for up to 3 people. Book the private undercover private car park. Among the amenities of our hotel in Paris 13th, we offer free luggage storage for 24 hours, a shop for small travel items as well as a guitar available at the reception desk. We also have beehives on the roof.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Maine Montparnasse 14th
hotels.description: In an old red-brick building, ibis Maine Montparnasse is a 10-min walk from Gare Montparnasse. For work or leisure, enjoy direct access to major event and tourist sites, like the Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and Paris Nord Villepinte, Eiffel Tower and Champs-Elysees. The hotel has 102 rooms with AC and new ibis bedding, free WiFi, bar and snack service and private parking, for a charge. Tight spaces.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Bastille
hotels.description: The Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Bastille welcomes you to the heart of Paris and is located a stone throw from the Place de la Bastille and close to the Gare de Lyon train station. The apartments are practical, smart and fully equipped, with a kitchen , bathroom, an office area in some studios, and free WIFI access. This is a truly sought-after location with the Bastille Opera house, Viaduc des Arts, River Seine and Metro all within walking distance.

hotels.name: TRIBE Paris Batignolles
hotels.description: TRIBE Paris Batignolles, a superb 4 star hotel, reflects the districts authenticity and friendliness, in a design world that defies convention. Celebrate joie de vivre during happy hour at the bar, unwind in our garden or immerse yourself in the cozy ambience of our social hub. Between visits or meetings, enjoy homemade dishes with fresh ingredients and signature cocktails by mixologist Matthias Giroud.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris 19eme Cité de la Musique
hotels.description: Aparthotel Adagio Paris 19 Cité de la Musique is located in Paris' 19th arrondissement, near Parc de la Villette. The aparthotel has 125 fully furnished, air-conditioned and soundproofed apartments with an equipped kitchen, accommodating up to 4 people. There is also a fitness center. Close to public transport and only 20 minutes from the center of Paris. Our reception desk is open 24/7. Pets are welcome.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Nation Porte de Montreuil
hotels.description: The ibis styles Paris Nation Porte de Montreuil offers an ideal setting for business and leisure trips. Close to Place de la Nation, the hotels location provides direct access to major tourist attractions: Eiffel Tower, Champs Elysees, Galeries Lafayette, Pere Lachaise Cemetery and Disneyland. Our hotel has 60 fully renovated and air conditioned rooms, with breakfast included in all our prices, 24-hour bar and snack offer and paid parking.
hotels.street: 36 Rue De La Croix Saint Simon

hotels.name: Ibis Styles Paris Jardin de la Villette
hotels.description: Breakfast and WIFI are included in all rates at ibis Styles Paris Jardin de la Villette. Stylish hotel with 40 rooms honoring Rosa Parks and Martin Luther King. Near Parc de La Villette, Zenith and 104. Metro line 7 (Crimée). RER E from Rosa Parks station to Gare du Nord and Gare Saint-Lazare. The Sacré-Coeur de Montmartre Basilica and the Louvre Museum are easily accessible via nearby public transport.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Montmartre North
hotels.description: On the right bank, north of Butte Montmartre (metro lines 12 & 4) and 15 min from Adidas Arena, ibis Styles Paris Montmartre Nord offers easy access to Gare du Nord, Gare de l'Est, Gare St-Lazare, Stade de France & Notre-Dame Cathedral. Ideal for business/leisure stays, the hotel has 45 renovated rooms with A/C to immerse you in a unique experience. Good news: breakfast & WIFI are incl. in the rate!

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Bercy Village
hotels.description: In the heart of Bercy Village and the dynamic East Parisian business district, Adagio Paris Bercy Village offers 139 apartments from 2 person studios to two room, four person apartments. Located a few steps from the Parc de Bercy and the quays of the Seine, the Aparthotel has very easy, 5 minute access to the Gare de Lyon, and 10 min access to the center of Paris by metro line 14. It has a seminar room that hosts up to 20 people.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Wagram Hotel
hotels.description: Near the Palais des Congrès, Porte Maillot and the Champs Elysées, just 10 minutes from the business district of La Défense, the Mercure Paris Arc de Triomphe Wagram Hotel is appreciated for its stylish and cozy setting. A welcoming hotel that invites you to relax after a day of work or shopping in the capital. Enjoy a delicious breakfast in your Family Room before setting off to explore Paris.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare du Nord Château-Landon 10ème
hotels.description: Ibis Paris Gare du Nord Château-Landon is in the north of Paris, 435 yd from Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est, 1.6 miles from Cité des Sciences and department stores in the Opéra district. RER B to Charles de Gaulle airport, Stade de France and central Paris: Châtelet, Les Halles, Saint-Michel, Notre-Dame. The hotel has 161 air-conditioned rooms, free WIFI, private garage, bar, terrace and 24/7 snacks.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Tour Eiffel Cambronne 15ème
hotels.description:
Just a 15-minute walk from the Eiffel Tower, our hotel is your ideal escape, featuring 527 comfortable rooms, some boasting breathtaking views of the Eiffel Tower.

Our hotel also offers convenient services like free WIFI, a 24-hour reception desk, well-equipped meeting rooms for your professional events, and a varied buffet breakfast tto get your day off to a great start.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Vaugirard Porte de Versailles Hotel
hotels.description: Welcome to Mercure Paris Vaugirard Porte de Versailles, ideally located opposite the Porte de Versailles exhibition centre and Dôme de Paris. The hotel offers 91 modern, air-conditioned rooms, a breakfast buffet, a friendly bar and a full spa with indoor pool, sauna, hammam, jacuzzi and fitness room. Flexible spaces are also available for meetings, seminars and coworking, for up to 200 people.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Opéra Faubourg Montmartre Hotel
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Opéra Faubourg Montmartre welcomes you to a quiet street in the 9th arrondissement. Behind its Art Deco facade, discover décor inspired by the 1930s and Joséphine Baker. Settle into our 4-star hotel in Paris, just steps from the Folies Bergère and the Grands Boulevards, for a getaway for two, family sightseeing or a business trip. Meet under the glass roof of the bar, enjoy a varied breakfast and work as a team in our 3 meeting rooms.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Opéra Lafayette
hotels.description: In a district that feels more like a warm and lively Parisian village, the Mercure Paris Opéra Lafayette will enchant you with its new décor. The Mercure Paris Opéra Lafayette, a name often mentioned, refers to Haussmann's Opera district and the Grands Boulevards close by. Famous musicians and lyricists have long left their mark on this district, which is watched over by their patron saint, Saint Cecilia.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris la Villette Aparthotel
hotels.description: The 3-star Adagio Access Paris La Villette is opposite Cité des Sciences, close to the park, the Grande Halle de La Villette, and the Zénith. There are 72 comfortable apartments with equipped kitchen, ranging from studios to 2-room apartments, along with free WIFI and two meeting rooms. Buses and the metro are next to the aparthotel. The establishment is not accessible to people with reduced mobility.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Montparnasse Pasteur
hotels.description: Inspired by Louis Pasteur's visionary spirit, Mercure Paris Montparnasse Pasteur invites you to explore and share. Feel at home from the very first moment. Our hotel has rooms for up to 4 guests, a sunlit glass atrium, co-working spaces, meeting rooms, L'Antidote bar and private parking. Experience the 15th arrondissement lifestyle with local gems, Parisian terraces and the Left Bank's authentic charm.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Alésia
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Alesia fully renovated 4-star hotel offering a warm and stylish setting in the 14th arrondissement. Ideal for business or a family stay in Paris, our hotel provides calm, modern rooms. Every morning, enjoy our breakfast, ranked 3rd best in France. Opposite Porte d Orleans metro station. Quick access: Montparnasse, St-Germain-des-Pres, Orly airport, university campus and Porte de Versailles.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon Opéra Bastille
hotels.description: Close to Gare de Lyon, behind elegant late-19th century façade discover Mercure Paris Gare de Lyon Opera Bastille, where French lifestyle and Haussmannian charm combine. Appreciate contemporary aesthetics associated with classic Parisian prestige. Ideal location, hushed comfort of Privilege rooms, refined ambience of bar and piano, will appeal to business guests, families and lovers of the Capital.

hotels.name: JO&JOE Paris Nation
hotels.description: JO&JOE Paris Nation is much more than a place to stay: a friendly, laid-back living space somewhere between a hostel and a hotel. Whether you're travelling solo, as a couple, with friends or in a group, choose from private rooms or dorms to suit every stay. Just steps from Place de la Nation, explore Paris, then unwind at the bar, in the restaurant or on our 100 m² rooftop. A lively spot where everyone is welcome!

hotels.name: Novotel Suites Paris Montreuil Vincennes
hotels.description: Why choose between comfort and location? For your stay in Paris, book a 323 sq.ft. suite at Green Key certified Novotel Suites Paris Montreuil Vincennes. From a Nespresso machine to a bathroom with shower and tub, few Parisian hotels offer such comfort. Children have a dedicated area to read and play, adults have the fitness ctr. From breakfast to aperitif, everyone can enjoy the relaxation and dining area.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Opéra Louvre Hotel
hotels.description: Located in a former Haussmann mansion right next to the Passage des Princes, the Hotel Mercure Paris Opéra Louvre offers comfortable, modern rooms with photographs by Michel Fraile. This fully renovated boutique hotel in Paris has preserved the late 19th century architecture in several rooms where you can enjoy a breakfast of local produce. And our gourmet shop is available if you're feeling peckish.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gare du Nord La Fayette 10th
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Gare du Nord La Fayette 10eme hotel promises an authentic Parisian experience. Fully renovated, the hotel has 70 modern and cozy rooms with air conditioning, new Sweet Bed by ibis bedding and high-speed WiFi. Kick-start the day with a buffet breakfast that includes a wide range of quality products. In the evening, enjoy a drink or a snack at the bar or in our private garden.

hotels.name: Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel
hotels.description: Ideally located at the foot of the Eiffel Tower and near Trocadero, Pullman Paris Tour Eiffel invites you to experience an unforgettable stay in the heart of the capital. The hotel has 430 rooms and suites, decorated in a modern and bright style. Some rooms offer a breathtaking view of the Eiffel Tower or the gardens. All rooms are equipped with a flat-screen TV with free movies and high-speed WIFI.
hotels.street: 18 avenue de Suffren, Entrée au 22 rue Jean Rey

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Centre Eiffel Tower
hotels.description: The Adagio Paris Tour Eiffel is by the River Seine near the Eiffel Tower, with panoramic views of Paris and its loveliest monuments. The 4-star aparthotel is superbly located for making the most of Parisian life and has 375 luxury apartments, from 2-person studios to 3-room apartments for 6 people. It also has an undercover private car park and two large meeting rooms.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Chatenay Malabry Paris Sud
hotels.description: The ibis Styles de Chatenay-Malabry hotel offers a rustic break right in the city, bordering parkland and shops and close to the Parc de la Vallee aux Loups and the Chateaubriand house. This friendly hotel will make everyone stay a delight.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Alesia Montparnasse
hotels.description: A 12-minute walk from Montparnasse train station, our hotel in the 14th arrondissement offers easy transport access to Paris's main sights. Our team is ready with a warm and friendly welcome. Our small, cozy rooms have all you need for your utmost comfort and a pleasant and relaxing stay. Enjoy our delicious buffet breakfast every morning (included), ideal for fueling up on energy for the day ahead.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Centre Tour Eiffel
hotels.description: In the heart of the capital, Novotel Paris Centre Tour Eiffel is a 4-star family hotel in a prime location. Near the Eiffel Tower, it offers suites with views of the Seine and has a renowned Japanese restaurant, Benkay. Located on Quai de Grenelle, it immerses you in Parisian life, very close to the emblematic monuments of the City of Light. The magic begins at breakfast under the bright glass roof.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Centre Eiffel Tower Hotel
hotels.description: Make the Mercure Paris Centre Tour Eiffel your favorite hotel near the Eiffel Tower. Enjoy the upscale comfort of Mercure for a tourist or business trip in a bright and cozy setting. Take advantage of the fitness center, restaurant and location near iconic landmarks. Our hotel has a car park and garden, 7 equipped modular meeting rooms for professional events, from the most intimate to the most grandiose.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte de Montreuil
hotels.description: For your utmost comfort, the hotel rooms and shared areas at the ibis Paris Porte de Montreuil are fully refurbished. There are triple and adjoining rooms for families and friends. Check out our breakfast room with a view over the rooftops of Paris! For your professional meetings and events, there are 3 well-lit and fully equipped seminar rooms available.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Alesia Montparnasse 14th
hotels.description: At ibis Paris Alésia Montparnasse, enjoy a refreshed setting with air-conditioned rooms, flat-screen TVs and WiFi. Discover the bistro-style menu at restaurant "Le Jardin des Plantes" and unwind at bar "Le 49", where snacks are available 24/7. For your events, 7 equipped meeting rooms are at your disposal, and you can take a break on the private, planted terrace. You also have access to our covered private car park all year round.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Bercy
hotels.description: Welcome to the ibis Styles Paris Bercy. Our hotel opens its doors to guests with a street art design concept by world-renowned artists. Enjoy an unforgettable stay with breakfast, WiFi and a cheerful welcome included. Ideal for business trips or attending an event at the Accor Arena. Our hotel combines comfort, originality, friendliness and an ideal location for a unique and unforgettable experience.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Eiffel Cambronne
hotels.description: With elegant contemporary décor, ibis Styles Paris Eiffel Cambronne highlights the most famous Parisian monument. Headboards in the rooms show the Eiffel Tower in lace; in the lobby and breakfast room, canvases make you feel immersed in the heart of the Iron Lady. In our unique hotel in Paris, family & friendly spirit, on a human scale, prevails. Relax on the furnished patio, very pleasant on sunny days.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris XV
hotels.description: Adagio Paris XV faces Parc des Expositions of Porte de Versailles, a few minutes away by transport, from the center of Paris. It has 183 studio apartments, 2 people in 2 rooms for 4 people, overlooking gardens and privately covered parking. The most lively areas of the XV Arrondissement and the Aquaboulard Water park are just a few steps away. An aparthotel that is ideal for a business or family stay.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Tour Montparnasse 15th
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Tour Montparnasse is a short walk from the train station and the Montparnasse Tower. The hotel has been completely renovated in 2019. For business or leisure stays, enjoy direct access to the Eiffel Tower, the Champs Elysees as well as the Exhibition Park of the Porte de Versailles and Paris Nord Villepinte. The hotel has 45 rooms with the new ibis bedding and WiFi. A bar and 24-hour snacks are available.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Gare de l'Est Château Landon
hotels.description: Located steps from the train and metro lines at Gare de l'Est and Château-Landon, the 3-star ibis Styles Paris Gare de l'Est Château Landon is a short 10-minute walk from Gare du Nord. Black and white, day and night, calm and excitement: the hotel embraces the contrasts that capture Paris' charm. The team's friendliness and contrasting design reflect the vibrant energy of the 10th arrondissement. Stroll along the Canal Saint-Martin before relaxing at the bar or enjoying a game of foosball.

hotels.name: ibis Paris la Villette Cite des Sciences 19th
hotels.description: Near Parc de la Villette and the Zenith, the ibis Paris la Villette Cite des Sciences 19eme hotel is an artistic stopover in central Paris. Sample creative dishes or a cocktail at the Handy bar and restaurant. Indulge in a post-concert snack available 24 hours. Here on business. Enjoy our parking lot and co-working space, as well as the view of Canal de l Ourcq from our meeting room and selected rooms.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris République Le Marais
hotels.description: The ibis Styles Paris Republique Le Marais, located in central Paris, offers an all-inclusive deal that includes breakfast, free WIFI and many other perks. With a stylish and colorful vibe-and 33 yards from Place de La Republique and the Metro lines-this hotel is perfect for a delightful and laidback stay, and is equipped for business guests, couples or families on vacation.

hotels.name: Hotel Mercure Paris 19 Philharmonie La Villette
hotels.description: BOOK YOUR PARKING SPACE: https://oneparkflow.com/mercure-paris-philharmonie We would like to inform you that our air conditioning system is currently not operating at optimal performance. Our teams are working around the clock to maintain a cool and pleasant atmosphere. This exceptional situation is reflected in our pricing. We appreciate your understanding.

hotels.name: Hotel Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse TGV
hotels.description: The Mercure Paris Gare Montparnasse TGV hotel is located in the heart of the city. Just 160 yards from the train station and 4 metro lines (4, 6, 12, 13), it makes visiting Paris easy. Its quiet and comfortable rooms are ideal for a business trip, romantic stay or family weekend. Some of our rooms offer a superb view of Paris' most beautiful monument, the Eiffel Tower. Enjoy an unforgettable stay.

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte d'Orleans
hotels.description: Welcome to the completely refurbished 2-star ibis budget Paris Porte d Orleans hotel, in the 14th arrondissement. Enjoy a very pleasant stay in air-conditioned rooms for up to 3 people. Whether you are on a business or leisure trip, our team is on hand 24 hours a day, so just ask.

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte de la Chapelle-Aréna
hotels.description: After a year and a half of complete renovations, ibis budget Paris Porte de la Chapelle - Arena is reopening its doors! This beautiful affordable hotel in the 18th arrondissement is close to Montmartre, Stade de France and Parc des Expositions in Villepinte. Convenient for business trips and ideal for leisure stays too. Our Double-Triple-Family Rooms are practical and stylish.

hotels.name: hotelF1 Paris Porte de Châtillon
hotels.description: Located in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, hotelF1 Paris Porte de Châtillon is within easy reach by public transport or car. Ideal for a stay with family, a city break with friends, or a business trip. Discover our 155 Cabrio rooms with private restrooms, combining comfort, practicality and design in a modern and affordable setting. Experience the hotelF1's new #ontheroad concept, designed for savvy travelers.
hotels.street: 23, Ave de la Porte de Châtillon

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris La Villette 19th
hotels.description: Near Gare de l Est Gare du Nord, ibis budget Paris La Villette offers quick access to the city most beautiful tourist sites. Cite des Sciences, Zenith 10-min on foot. Sacre-Coeur or Champs-Elysees are 15 and 25 min by metro. Rooms offer free WIFI and sleep up to 3 people. From your budget hotel, stroll along the banks of Bassin de la Villette or in Parc des Buttes Chaumont. Paying undercover car park.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Sud Villejuif Residence
hotels.description: Opposite Gustave Roussy Institute and by metro line 14, Mercure Paris Sud Villejuif offers quick access to central Paris and Orly Airport. 77 studios and apartments with AC, equipped kitchen, workspace and flat-screen TV. Plus private parking, luggage storage, fast WIFI, co-working space, 24 hours reception, buffet breakfast and rooftop with Eiffel Tower view. Ideal for couples, families or business guests.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Levallois Perret Hotel
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Levallois Perret is on the edge of Neuilly-sur-Seine, between Espace Champerret and the Palais des Congrès de la Porte Maillot. Fully renovated in a contemporary style, the hotel offers an elegant, warm and welcoming atmosphere. Its modern, comfortable rooms provide the perfect place to unwind after a day of work or exploring. You can also relax on the outdoor patio, a pleasant spot to take a break.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Boulogne Billancourt
hotels.description: The 3-star ibis Boulogne Billancourt is just 50 metres from Billancourt metro station (Line 9), with direct access to Paris’s main attractions. It offers 52 air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, plus a snack service available 24/7. A private car park with 3 spaces is located 50 metres from the hotel and costs €17 per night. It is reserved for standard-size vehicles and is not suitable for larger vehicles. Clef Verte certified hotel (www.laclefverte.org).

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Massy Gare TGV Hotel
hotels.description: Feel at home at Mercure Paris Massy Gare TGV where our team will take care of you! Located in the heart of the Massy Atlantis business district, 4 mins by foot from the TGV/RER station. After a day at work or sightseeing, enjoy a drink in our bar lounge, experience "Made in Massy" dining on the terrace, and sleep in one of our extremely comfortable beds.

hotels.name: TRIBE Paris Saint Ouen
hotels.description: In a charming, lively district, our hotel in Saint-Ouen has 112 rooms with a chic decor for business/leisure stays in Paris. Enjoy the social hub and relax on the comfy seats, read a book from the library or work remotely with fast WIFI. On fine days, the courtyard and green terrace become a secret garden, ideal for relaxing with a cold drink, a coffee or a cocktail served with local produce from the bar.

hotels.name: TRIBE Paris Clichy
hotels.description: Experience the urban and artistic energy of TRIBE Paris Clichy. In this lively district, feel at home in our 120 smart, stylish rooms for leisure or work. From the restaurant to the rooftop, each living space is on trend: a subtle mix of materials and colors create an ultra-modern ambiance. The social hub at the heart of the hotel combines relaxation, a place for sharing and a co-working space in Clichy.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Val de Fontenay
hotels.description: Welcome to the Novotel Paris Val de Fontenay, in the Val de Fontenay business district just 50 yards from RER station lines A and E. The new hotel has 100 high-quality air-conditioned rooms, and a lounge bar for socializing, making it an ideal stopover for leisure or business, with easy links to La Defense and only 25 minutes from Disneyland Paris.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Pont de Levallois Neuilly Hotel
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Pont de Levallois Neuilly combines comfort, style and authenticity in a modern and warm ambience. In Levallois, on the outskirts of Paris, it offers quick access to La Défense, Porte Maillot and Palais des Congrès. Enjoy its interior terrace, a true peaceful haven. "Come and experience Paris a different way. Our team will be happy to make your stay memorable." - Mona BOULMEDAIS, Manager.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Stade Basilique
hotels.description: Near Stade de France and St-Denis Pleyel district, our 4-star Novotel Paris Stade France Basilique Hotel is ideal for dreaming, having fun or working. Discover a zen universe for enjoying shared moments. Admire views of Paris and the Eiffel Tower from our rooftop bar. Taste home-cooked food on our restaurants leafy courtyard or work out in the fitness center. We have 7 smart, modern meeting rooms.
hotels.street: 1 Place de la Porte de Paris

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Suresnes Longchamp
hotels.description: The Novotel Paris Suresnes Longchamp hotel is located west of Paris, just 10 minutes from La Défense and the Palais des Congrès Porte Maillot. Our hotel features 113 spacious, comfortable and soundproofed rooms with free WiFi. Guests can enjoy a cozy bar, a bright and modern restaurant, on-site parking and five fully equipped, adaptable meeting rooms.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte de Vanves Parc des Expositions
hotels.description: The ibis Paris-Vanves Parc des Expositions hotel has 71 quiet, renovated rooms with A/C. There is free WIFI and a 24/7 bar, as well as private underground parking. Ideal for business and family stays, the hotel is close to Porte de Versailles exhibition center and Palais des Sports. Guests can reach central Paris, Montparnasse train station and the Eiffel Tower in a few minutes by metro.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Gennevilliers
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Gennevilliers hotel is ideally located on the outskirts of Paris, and has 60 rooms, a 24-hour bar, a restaurant and 2 meeting rooms. It is 328 yds, 300 m from Les Agnettes metro station on line 13 to the Champs Elysees, Montmartre and Opera. It is also close to the Stade de France, the Paris Air Show, the Palais Des Congres center and La Defense business district, making it a great place to stay for business and pleasure. Our 3-star hotel is close to all shops and opposite a shopping mall.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Boulogne Pont de Saint-Cloud Hotel
hotels.description: Paris Boulogne Pont de Saint Cloud - Elegance and comfort at the gateway to Paris. Stay in a fully renovated hotel, combining contemporary design, comfort, and premium services. Just steps from the metro, enjoy a prime location. Roland Garros, Parc des Princes, and La Seine Musicale are all within easy reach. Elegant rooms, lounge bar with terrace, wellness area with sauna, bright seminar rooms. Experience Paris differently, in a calm and refined setting.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Coeur d'Orly Airport
hotels.description: For a stopover, business trip or visit to Paris, Novotel Paris Coeur d'Orly Airport invites you for a comfy stay at Paris-Orly Airport, near Terminal 4. Settle in for a night or more in our spacious and bright rooms with the N'ROOM by Novotel concept. Sip a drink on the bar terrace, enjoy cuisine with international flavors at Globe Cro'Coeur restaurant or admire the runways from the panoramic fitness ctr.
hotels.street: 19 Rue d'Orly, 5 rue élise deroche. Parking add

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Boulogne hotel
hotels.description: On the edge of Paris, the 4-star Mercure Paris Boulogne welcomes you in an elegant, modern ambience. In the heart of Boulogne-Billancourt, a 15-minute walk from Parc des Princes, organize memorable seminars in the auditorium and 13 modular meeting rooms. In summer, relax with a drink at our rooftop bar with pool. Enjoy fine cuisine at 16.9, our restaurant with terrace.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Val de Fontenay Hotel
hotels.description: Near the RER A and E, with direct access to La Defense and less than 30 mins from Disneyland Paris, Marne la Vallee, the Mercure Paris Val de Fontenay will meet all your needs for business trips or family stays. Our 4 star hotel has 8 spacious and renovated seminar rooms, a fitness room for sporty types, a bar with a happy hour and a restaurant serving homemade products and a patio for sunny days.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Saclay
hotels.description: Built around a former farmstead just minutes from the Saclay scientific and technological hub and several grandes ecoles, Novotel Paris Saclay promises a stay that combines business and leisure. We offer 15 conference rooms, an outdoor pool, a fitness room, a miniature golf course, and spaces for playing tennis, volleyball and petanque. Take time out to sip a cocktail on the terrace. In our restaurant, you can savour honey from on-site beehives and produce from our own vegetable garden.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Porte de Versailles Expo Hotel
hotels.description: Welcoming you in its immense atrium bathed in light, Mercure Paris Porte de Versailles Expo is ideal for a family stay with its connecting rooms. Popular with delegates and business travellers, our Vanves hotel also is there for your professional events with its 18 seminar rooms, total capacity of 300 people. You can count on our lounge bar and our restaurant serving French and international dishes.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Nation Davout
hotels.description: Discover the ibis Paris Nation Davout hotel: a privileged location, just 15 minutes by metro from Gare de Lyon and a 15-minute walk from Place de la Nation. Near metro line 9 so you can quickly reach the main tourist attractions such as the Champs-Élysées, Eiffel Tower, Trocadero, Galeries Lafayette and Parc des Princes. The T3A and T3B tram lines are a convenient option for exploring the city.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris La Defense Nanterre
hotels.description: Welcome to Novotel Paris La Defense Nanterre, your new elegant and contemporary hotel located in the dynamic district of La Defense. With its 170 spacious rooms, family rooms, a refined bar, quality restaurant, fitness center and 4,305 sq.ft. of spaces dedicated to seminars, this hotel will quickly become an unmissable destination for your business trips and family leisure stays.

hotels.name: TRIBE Paris Pantin
hotels.description: TRIBE Paris Pantin mirrors the vibrant energy of this bustling city. Discover a stylish hotel with smart, inspired spaces. Your stay begins at the social hub, a place for creativity and enjoyment. Relax in a lounge for an impromptu co-working session or near the bar to plan your next activities. Kick-start your day with a fresh, local breakfast or experience la dolce vita in our Italian restaurant.

hotels.name: TRIBE Paris Suresnes
hotels.description: TRIBE Paris Suresnes is a haven for curious and creative urban minds. 104 stylish rooms offering comfort and style. Gourmet buffet breakfast with carefully selected products. The restaurant and bar have an Australian influence: fresh, seasonal cuisine to share or enjoy solo. Flat white or chai latte during the day, cocktails in the evening. Vibrant ambience, great music: you will never want to leave.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Boulogne Aparthotel
hotels.description: Ideal for a family holiday, Mercure Apparthotel Paris Boulogne offers various apartments from Studio to 2 rooms for your stay. For a few days or weeks, our Boulogne-Billancourt hotel allows you to choose between our bar-restaurant or the kitchen area of your private accommodation. You will also have access to a laundromat and paid covered parking. You will feel at home, while benefiting from our services.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte de Bagnolet
hotels.description: ibis Paris Porte de Bagnolet in east Paris is ideal for business and leisure. All rooms are air-conditioned and have WiFi. Our bar has a lounge area and the "ibis kitchen" serves simple, delicious cuisine. Our market-style breakfast is an all-you-can-eat continental buffet with warm and chilled options, available from 6.30 am in our breakfast room on the 1st floor.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Nord Porte de Saint Ouen
hotels.description: Welcome to the Ibis Paris Nord Porte de Saint-Ouen hotel, near the famous Marché aux Puces and Montmartre. The hotel offers 117 modern rooms with free WIFI, a relaxing garden, private parking and electric charging stations. Perfect for business or leisure travelers, with quick access to Paris' attractions and city center.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Meudon Vélizy
hotels.description: Ideally located in the heart of the Velizy - Paris Ouest business hub, ibis Paris Meudon Velizy is ideal for business trips. Near the Velizy-Villacoublay business parks and major roads A86, N118, it offers 94 rooms with AC, bar with catering, meeting room, high-speed WIFI, undercover parking with EV chargers and a fitness center. On the edge of Meudon Forest, it offers a quiet environment after work.

hotels.name: TRIBE Paris La Défense Esplanade
hotels.description: The city-styled TRIBE Paris La Défense hotel is in a natural setting near the esplanade. The ultra-comfortable rooms are a home from home. The cuisine is a nod to TRIBE's Australian roots while privileging local produce, and the bar makes life more inclusive by offering low-alcohol cocktails. This is a luxurious and friendly 4-star hotel, with PRM facilities, and a practical designer space for meeting up.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Nanterre
hotels.description: The Mercure Paris Nanterre welcomes you in a chic and warm setting inspired by the city's industrial history. Four bright meeting rooms are available for business events. Enjoy a grand cru at the wine bar La Vinothèque or discover the inventive and refined cuisine of Bistro Mirlot. With a private parking garage and a strategic location near Paris La Défense Arena, everything is in place to make your visit as convenient as it is comfortable.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Charles-de-Gaulle Airport
hotels.description: Admire the aerial ballet from your fully renovated room. In the heart of CDG Airport's Terminal 3, the hotel has spacious, soundproofed rooms and suites with AC. Perfect for families. Dive into an inviting setting and enjoy culinary creations at LUIZA restaurant from its contemporary and stylish terrace. For your seminars, why not use one of the hotel's five modern and functional meeting rooms?
hotels.street: Rue de Paris, Roissypole Gare RER

hotels.name: Mercure Paris CDG Airport
hotels.description: Transform your layover into a moment of well-being. The 4-star Mercure Paris CDG Airport hotel promises a comfortable stopover during your travels or business trip. Park your car securely at our CDG Airport hotel parking. Dream in our upscale, soundproofed rooms, some with runway views. Enjoy our fitness center, unwind in our indoor pool with terrace, dine in our restaurant or opt for an early breakfast.
hotels.street: Roissypôle Ouest, Route de la Commune, Cedex

hotels.name: Novotel Paris 13 Porte d'Italie
hotels.description: Giving pride of place to street art in the image of its district, the Novotel Paris 13 Porte d Italie hotel offers spacious bedrooms with modern decor. With a meeting room and a coworking space, our hotel in Kremlin-Bicetre also offers fun with family or friends around its board games or video games. To relax at the end of the day, come and discover our beers in our bar.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Levallois Perret
hotels.description: Located in the heart of Levallois, just a stone throw from the Louise Michel metro station, the ibis Levallois Perret hotel is perfectly located for getting to St Lazare, Porte Maillot, La Défense and the Espace Champerret. The ibis Levallois Perret hot el has 53 completely renovated rooms, equipped with the new Sweet Bed by ibis bedding, air-conditioning and free WIFI. The hotel also has a bar with a terrace and a 24-hour snack service. Paying public car park close to the hotel.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte de Clichy Centre
