hotels.description: The ibis Paris Porte de Clichy Centre hotel is Green Key certified. Opposite the Nouveau Tribunal and close to the Batignolles district, it welcomes you for a business stay, a weekend or a family trip. Comfortable rooms with Nespresso machine, memory foam pillows and Chromecast TV, free WIFI and quick metro/RER access to the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, the Arc de Triomphe and Stade de France.
hotels.street: 15, boulevard Victor Hugo, Place des Nations-Unies

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Porte de Pantin Hotel
hotels.description: With renovated rooms and suites in a chic, modern style and views of the Philharmonie de Paris, this hotel boasts a privileged location close to the Zenith, the Halles de la Villette and the Cite des Sciences. Well-served by public transport, the hotel is  a lively spot thanks to its restaurant with a garden terrace in the summer offering refined, authentic cuisine, relaxation areas and a cozy bar. Enjoy a varied breakfast before heading out to explore the capital.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Saint-Denis Stade Sud
hotels.description: Our budget hotel is Green Key certified. Green Key is the leading international sustainable tourism label for tourist accommodation and restaurants in France. Just steps from Stade de France and the Olympic Aquatic Centre, it offers spacious renovated, air-conditioned rooms. Enjoy breakfast every morning and our bar open 24/7. Private gated parking with EV charging points is available at an additional charge. Welcome home!
hotels.street: Rue de la Cokerie, Av Francis Pressense

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte de Bercy
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Porte de Bercy boasts classic, comfortable rooms with A/C. Check out our breakfast buffet's generous and varied selection as soon as you wake up. Enjoy it-it's all you can eat! For your work trips, the hotel has several fully equipped seminar rooms that can host up to 110 people. There's nothing like a good meal to unwind! Our restaurant chef has also put together a tasty, traditional menu.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Place d'Italie 13th
hotels.description: Ibis Paris Place d Italie 13eme hotel welcomes you to Place d Italie. Metro lines 5-6-7, near Austerlitz, Montparnasse and Lyon stations. 72 rooms with WIFI, AC in summer and heating in winter, incl. 3 rooms adapted for people with reduced mobility. The bar, 24-hour snack service and our terrace are at your disposal. The hotel also has paid private parking upon reservation. Pets allowed for a supplement.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Orly Rungis
hotels.description: A partner for your seminars and functions, Novotel Paris Orly Rungis offers 13 meeting rooms, as well as a range of business, executive and family guest rooms. The outdoor pool, open during summer months, and the fitness centre are ideal for relaxing and revitalising between business events or sightseeing excursions. Our hotel in Rungis also has gourmet moments in store for you. The bar tempts you with housemade cocktails, while the restaurant serves up tasty dishes in the dining room or on the terrace.
hotels.street: 1 rue du pont des halles, Zone du delta

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Orly Airport
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Orly Airport is a sunny stopover before your vacation or business trip. A few minutes by transport from Orly airport, enjoy the vacation vibe in our Mediterranean atmosphere. In a leafy yet industrial decor, relax in the bar and play foosball, table tennis or billiards. Enjoy the wait for your flight in our restaurant or take advantage of the spacious rooms designed for workers and families.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Nord Expo Aulnay
hotels.description: Located in the heart of the most important business area of Europe and the future Grand Paris Express, the recently renovated 4-star Novotel Paris Nord Expo will welcome you during your professional and personal stays. Come discover new flavors at our gourmet bar restaurant for lunch or dinner. Every week, the Chef creates using fresh produce. Enjoy our many services, incl. outdoor pool and free WiFi.
hotels.street: 65 Rue Michel ange, Carrefour de l' Europe, SEINE SAINT DENIS

hotels.name: ibis Paris Issy Les Moulineaux Val de Seine
hotels.description: The ibis Issy-les-Moulineaux hotel is located near the Seine Musicale, Ile de St Germain and Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. It has 164 comfortable, air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI, a restaurant open for lunch and dinner, 4 seminar rooms and a private car park. You can also start your day with our rich, fresh, gourmet and diverse buffet breakfast!

hotels.name: ibis Paris La Défense Esplanade
hotels.description: In the heart of the La Defense business district, the ibis Paris La Defense Centre hotel is ideally situated between the Grande Arche and the Arc de Triomphe. The hotel boasts a restaurant, bar and 286 air-conditioned rooms with free WIFI access. The near by Esplanade de la Defense metro station, line 1, provides easy access to the Porte Maillot convention center, the Champs Elysees and even the 4 Temps shopping mall within 10 minutes.
hotels.street: 4 Boulevard de Neuilly, Paris La Défense Cedex

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Ivry Quai de Seine Hotel
hotels.description: 5 minutes from Porte de Bercy, the Mercure Paris Ivry Quai de Seine hotel was renovated at the start of 2026 and offers rooms overlooking the river. Enjoyed by business travelers, our hotel in Ivry-sur-Seine has 10 meeting rooms and a business lounge to host your meetings. We offer tasty French cuisine with fresh seasonal produce, as well as a gourmet, healthy breakfast and a cozy bar.

hotels.name: ibis Paris la Defense Courbevoie
hotels.description: By the River Seine, the 3-star ibis Paris La Defense Courbevoie offers a comfy, affordable stay on the edge of Paris, near the La Defense business district. Some rooms have views of the Seine and the Eiffel Tower. During the day, after visiting the capital or before a concert at Paris La Defense Arena, take advantage of our bar in Courbevoie, open 24 hours, with its terrace and selection of light snacks.
hotels.street: 39 Quai Paul Doumer, Accès piéton: 60 rue Victor Hugo

hotels.name: Pullman Paris la Defense
hotels.description: The upscale Pullman Paris La Defense hotel is a cozy and sparkling break with spacious designer rooms in La Defense business district, 10 minutes from the Champs-Elysees. There are delicious treats at the Quinte and Sens restaurant with its open kitchen, you can enjoy a drink at the bar, and there is also a gym and wellness area, WIFI, private parking, and meeting spaces for conferences and functions.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Pont de Sevres
hotels.description: For work or leisure, enjoy the modern and comfortable atmosphere of Novotel Paris Pont de Sèvres! Inspired by the industrial character of the city, our hotel blends wood and metal to create a relaxing atmosphere. Come relax by the fireplace in our bar or savor a moment on the restaurant terrace. Our hotel in Sèvres features 11 bright, modular meeting rooms, plus fun and relaxation in our common areas with video games and foosball.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Rueil Malmaison
hotels.description: A partner for professional meetings and events, Novotel Paris Rueil Malmaison offers 14 meeting rooms and a conference hall. Our hotel in Rueil-Malmaison also welcomes families and tourists, and offers modern, stylish rooms and a fitness center. As for dining, discover delicious cuisine in a cozy and relaxed atmosphere. On fine days, relax on our new terrace and make the most of the moment.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Charenton-le-Pont
hotels.description: On the edge of the Bois de Vincennes, the 4-star Novotel Paris Charenton le Pont is a prime address on the outskirts of Paris. Whether you're here for a family stay, a business trip or a corporate event, our hotel in Charenton-le-Pont enjoys an ideal location in a peaceful town just minutes from the capital. Committed to the environment, our hotel is Green Key certified.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris La Defense Hotel
hotels.description: A bubble of serenity, the 4-star Mercure Paris La Défense contrasts with the sparkling atmosphere of the business district. Near Les 4 Temps shopping mall, relax in this urban oasis. After a day of shopping, meetings or seminars in one of our meeting rooms, celebrate your success at the rooftop bar with panoramic view of Paris. Hungry? Enjoy seasonal cuisine at Vingko, a gourmet restaurant in La Défense.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Coeur d'Orly Airport
hotels.description: Near Orly Terminal 4, ibis Paris Coeur d'Orly guarantees comfort and practicality. An automated walkway leads directly to Orly Airport. For a stress-free business or leisure stay, travel alone, in a group or with your pet. Take advantage of the paid undercover car park and the buffet breakfast served from 4am. Relax at the bar or enjoy delicious authentic dishes at our restaurant's Mediterranean buffet.

hotels.name: ibis Paris CDG Airport
hotels.description: Ibis Paris CDG Airport is your convenient hotel near Terminal 3 and the CDGVAL connecting Terminals 1 and 2 of Charles-de-Gaulle Airport. Early flight? Trade show? Stopover night? Settle into one of our soundproofed rooms for up to 6 people. Fancy a quick bite or full dinner? Two restaurants, a coffee spot and a bar await you. 13 meeting rooms are at your disposal for your meetings or study days.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Orly Rungis Airport
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Orly Rungis Airport is the ideal base for your business or leisure trips. There is a hearty breakfast buffet with varied regional fare, and L EPHANCIEL restaurant has a menu for all tastes, with dining facilities on the terrace, in the restaurant or as room service. The spacious bedrooms provide all the comforts for relaxing throughout your stay.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Sud Les Ulis Courtaboeuf Hotel
hotels.description: Come and discover our recently renovated, Green Key-certified hotel. Located in the Courtaboeuf area near Saclay, the 4-star Mercure Paris Sud Les Ulis hotel is ideal for business meetings, exploring Paris or relaxing by the pool in summer and the fireplace in winter. In a setting designed for relaxation, discover our spacious and comfortable rooms, and enjoy honey from our very own beehives at breakfast.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Gennevilliers Hotel
hotels.description: Open since 2018, the Mercure Paris Gennevilliers hotel boasts 144 large and contemporary rooms. The decor, an elegant blend of modernity and chic design, pays tribute to Gennevilliers' industrial past. Ideal for work or leisure stays, our services are designed for your comfort with a fitness center, secure parking and trendy bar. Reach downtown Paris in 20 minutes from Les Courtilles metro.
hotels.street: 3, Avenue Des Louvresses, Zac Des Louvresses

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Roissy CDG Convention
hotels.description: Novotel Paris Roissy CDG Convention welcomes you five minutes from Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport and near the capitals unmissable sights. Use the on-site parking and enjoy a gourmet breakfast served from 6am. Relax in the hotels heated indoor pool before enjoying a chic dinner at the Gourmet Bar. On a business trip? Our meeting rooms can accommodate your conventions and seminars for up to 400 people.

hotels.name: greet Paris Porte de la Chapelle-Aréna
hotels.description: Discover Paris first greet hotel. Local and eco-friendly, this renovated 2-star hotel is near Montmartre, Stade de France and the Exhibition Center. Ideal for work or leisure trips, our double and family rooms are warm and stylish. Easy access to Gare du Nord, CDG Airport. Near Porte de La Chapelle, quick access to the beltway and A1. Enjoy a unique experience at greet Paris Porte de la Chapelle-Arena.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Ornano Montmartre North 18th
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Ornano Montmartre is in the 18th arrondissement, near the Sacré-Coeur and the lively Montmartre district. Our extremely comfortable rooms are equipped with A/C, cozy beds and stylish bathrooms. Our breakfast will give you the energy you need to make the most of your stay. After a busy day exploring the charms and secrets of Paris, you can relax at the hotel's bar.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris La Défense Esplanade
hotels.description: Part of the iconic skyline, Novotel Paris La Defense Esplanade invites you to a relaxing urban hotel for families and business guests. Both near yet away from the hustle and bustle of La Defense. Join the locals at the Greem restaurant, play foosball in the lobby, enjoy drinks with friends or work out in the fitness center. Want to shine? Our nine meeting rooms will stimulate your creative spirit.
hotels.street: 2 Boulevard de Neuilly, Paris La Défense Cedex

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Porte d'Orléans Hotel
hotels.description: The Mercure Paris Porte d'Orléans hotel is your gateway to the best-kept secrets south of Paris. Before discovering these gems, head to your surprisingly quiet room in this lively district. Vintage decor, seasonal cuisine, vibrant hues and modern amenities make our hotel the ideal base for business trips, family vacations or sports travel. Need help with directions or local advice? Our staff are experts.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Le Bourget Hotel
hotels.description: Located close to the Bourget and Villepeinte Parcs des Expositions, the Musee de l air et de l espace, Parc Asterix and the Stade de France, the Mercure Paris Le Bourget hotel has stylish rooms. Easy to access from the highway networks A1, A3 and A104  and 15 min from the Roissy Charles de Gaulle Airport. After a day of work in one of our meeting rooms, relax in the restaurant, on the pool-side terrace or by savoring a glass of wine at the hotel bar.
hotels.street: 2  Rue Jean Perrin, LE BLANC MESNIL CEDEX

hotels.name: ibis Paris Pantin Eglise
hotels.description: The ibis Paris Pantin Eglise hotel is located in downtown Pantin, right next to Eglise de Pantin metro station, Line 5. Ideal for stays close to Paris, the hotel has spacious, 248 sq. ft. rooms with AC and free WiFi. Some rooms can sleep up to 4 people, and there are 3 rooms adapted for people with reduced mobility. Feeling peckish. The hotel bar is available 24 hours a day to satisfy small cravings.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris La Défense Grande Arche Hotel
hotels.description:

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Roissy Charles de Gaulle Hotel
hotels.description: Mercure Paris Roissy Charles de Gaulle immerses you in a quintessentially Parisian decor - with nods to Montmartre, the Citroen 2CV, Haussmannian boulevards and works by local artists. Our hotel in Roissy-en-France offers 5 meeting rooms and a large car park. During your downtime, relax on the terrace or play a game of billiards, table tennis, Wii or pinball. Savour products from the local market at breakfast, and taste the selection of wines in our restaurant Before Paris .

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte d'Orléans
hotels.description: Located in Montrouge, ibis Paris Porte d Orleans welcomes you in a lovely setting near the capital. After a day at an international trade show or sightseeing, rest in one of our warmly colored rooms. Enjoy breakfast on the terrace, dine at the restaurant or sip on a drink at the friendly bar, without leaving the comfort of your ibis hotel in the Paris metropolitan area. We also organize concerts.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Porte d'Italie
hotels.description: In the heart of the 13th arrondissement, ibis Paris Porte d'Italie is an ideal destination for family vacations or business trips to Paris. Our friendly team is happy to welcome you to our restaurant by offering à la carte dining. To make your stay even more enjoyable, the hotel has an indoor car park and is a short walk from the metro and tram that will take you to downtown Paris.

hotels.name: Mercure Paris Velizy Hotel
hotels.description: Stay in one of our spacious 323 ft2 rooms. Take the family to Meudon Forest or visit Versailles and Paris. Prepare to splurge at one of the 180 stores in nearby Westfield Mall. Back at the hotel, relax in our 90F heated indoor pool, round off the day with one of our regional beverages, then enjoy the seasonal flavors of our chefs cuisine.

hotels.name: ibis Paris Pont de Suresnes
hotels.description: In the heart of Suresnes, ibis Paris Pont de Suresnes is an air-conditioned hotel with 62 rooms, each with a private bathroom. It’s ideal for a stay near Paris and La Défense. There are 35 rooms with a double bed, 18 with two single beds and 9 triple rooms. A bar, coworking space, breakfast room and outdoor terrace complete the offering. Shops and restaurants are close by, with buses just a 2-minute walk away and tram line T2 8 minutes away. Paid public parking is nearby.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Créteil Le Lac
hotels.description: The Novotel Paris Créteil Le Lac, renovated in April 2019, invites you for a stay by the shore in a lush green setting. Enjoy a room with a lakeside view for a guaranteed change of scenery. Discover our terrace with a pool and 12 meeting rooms for your work meetings. Feeling peckish? Our restaurant has homemade brasserie-style cuisine. Enjoy our free and secure parking lot with electric charging stations.

hotels.name: ibis Paris 17 Clichy-Batignolles
hotels.description:
Our location is perfect for business trips, family getaways or sightseeing visits. The 3-star hotel offers a choice of five room types, all with air conditioning. Enjoy complimentary WIFI and on-site dining. Nineteen meeting rooms with natural daylight are available for your business events.
If you are coming by car, we also have available parking (payment required). Our reception desk is available 24 hours a day.

hotels.name: Novotel Paris Est Centre De Conference
hotels.description: On the outskirts of the capital, Novotel Paris Est Centre De Conférence is located in a quiet residential area in Bagnolet. hotels.name: hotelF1 Paris Porte de Montreuil
hotels.description: Located on the outskirts of the 20th arrondissement, hotelF1 Paris Porte de Montreuil offers economy #ontheroad rooms, including 80 with private bathrooms. hotels.name: hotelF1 Paris Gennevilliers

hotels.name: hotelF1 Paris Saint Denis Stade

hotels.name: hotelF1 Paris Saint Ouen - Marché aux Puces
hotels.description: The hotelF1 Paris Saint Ouen Marche aux Puces is close to top Paris attractions like the famous Flea Market, Sacre Coeur, Moulin Rouge and Stade de France. hotels.name: hotelF1 Paris Saint-Denis Université
hotels.description: Just steps from Paris 8 University and a 15-minute walk from the Stade de France, hotelF1 Paris Saint-Denis Université welcomes you night and day. Electric charging stations available.

hotels.name: Hôtel Mercure Paris Saint Cloud Hippodrome
hotels.description:
Set in a former family guesthouse, our hotel draws on the emblematic blue of Saint-Cloud soft porcelain, a subtle thread running through the atmosphere.
Ideal for private or business events, it offers a meeting room for up to 20 guests and a terrace filled with natural light.
Every morning, enjoy breakfast with a selection of local produce for a delicious, authentic start to the day.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris La Defense Courbevoie
hotels.description: Reminiscent of artists studios by design, bathed in a comfortable, warm atmosphere, ibis Styles Paris La Defense Courbevoie brings an unusual touch to your business stays in La Defense. All rooms are air-conditioned. Particular care has been taken in their interior design, both visually pleasing and relaxing.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Vincennes
hotels.description: Ideally located a stone throw from the Chateau de Vincennes, not far from the Paris zoo and the floral park. This aparthotel is well served by public transport with access to the center of Paris in just 20 minutes. The aparthotel offers 90 studios and 2 -room apartments, all with a fully equipped kitchen, ideal for long stays. The aparthotel offers a private car park and a fitness room.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Porte d'Orleans
hotels.description: The ibis Styles Paris Porte d Orleans hotel offers colorful, spacious and soundproofed bedrooms. Free WIFI and a buffet breakfast are included in the room price. It also has a friendly bar, two meeting rooms bathed in natural daylight, an indoor garden with terrace and a secure private car park.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Villejuif
hotels.description: Welcome to ibis Styles Paris Villejuif, 160 yards from metro line 7 and Tram T7: Villejuif Louis Aragon. Paris is less than 20 mins by metro. The hotel s fun and kaleidoscopic design is inspired by the kids of pop and features references to French music, cinema and fashion from the 70s to 90s. Fast access to Paris Orly Airport, Rungis Market, Villejuif Bio Park, Grand Parc and Gustave Roussy campuses.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Romainville
hotels.description: Looking for a getaway near Paris? Welcome to ibis Styles Paris Romainville, 330 yards from metro line 5 (Bobigny-Pantin-Raymond Queneau station)! Discover Eastern Paris: Parc de la Villette, Canal de l'Ourcq, Canal Saint-Martin, Zénith de Paris, Stade de France. 10-20 minutes by metro! Close to the Villepinte exhibition center and with quick access to Le Bourget and Roissy-CDG airports.

hotels.name: ibis Montlhéry Paris Sud
hotels.description: 12.4 miles south of Paris, between Saclay, Massy, Orly and Évry, ibis Montlhéry welcomes you 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Enjoy 131 air-conditioned rooms with 43" TV, free high-speed WIFI, a restaurant, bar and recreational spaces (culture, music, video games). Two meeting rooms can accommodate up to 80 people. Secure private parking with charging stations and a 21,525 sq.ft. fitness center 55 yd away.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Vanves Porte de Chatillon
hotels.description: On the outskirts of Paris, the Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Vanves Porte de Chatillon offers easy access to the exhibition center at Porte de Versailles and the Paris Palais des Sports arena. This 3-star holiday residence offers 79 furnished apartments, each equipped wi th a kitchen. Public transport is easily accessible in this tranquil residential neighborhood. The Aparthotel also offers an underground car park.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Haussmann Champs-Elysees
hotels.description: Right next to the Champs-Elysees and the Opera district, the Adagio Paris Haussmann Champs-Elysees offers 53 comfortable apartments from the 2-person studio to the 2-rooms for 4-persons. Classified as a 4 star holiday residence, it combines refinement and high-quality amenities. The area, a bustling business center, is full of tourist hotspots: the Madeleine, Arc de Triomphe, Louvre and Tuileries Garden.

hotels.name: Novotel Suites Paris Stade de France
hotels.description: Combine comfort and freedom at the Novotel Suites Stade de France. Our 323 sq.ft. suites accommodate up to 4 people and offer many amenities. Tea or espresso, an energizing shower or relaxing bath: the choice is yours any time, day or night. Feel at home with memory foam mattress, microwave, and fridge. In this 101-room 4-star hotel, the gym is open 24/7 and the Boutique Gourmande offers hot meals, salads, and desserts.

hotels.name: greet Hotel Paris 13 Porte d'Italie
hotels.description: Greet to see you. Welcome to greet Hotel Paris 13 Porte d'Italie. For family or business stays, come and discover our eco-friendly hotel on the edge of Paris' 13th arrondissement. In nearby Chinatown, you can enjoy a total change of scenery in the busy streets that are reminiscent of Shanghai. Be Greet.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Boulogne
hotels.description: The Adagio Paris Boulogne aparthotel is in southwest Paris and a 10-min walk from La Seine Musicale, 2 metro stops from Parc des Princes and a 10-min drive from Roland Garros and Porte de Versailles Convention Center. hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Porte de Pantin Philharmonie
hotels.description: Discover our 74-room ibis Styles hotel with 1930s Parisian decor and a leafy setting. You can discover Parc de la Villette, the Philharmonie de Paris, the Grande Halle de la Villette, Cité des Sciences and the Zénith.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Mairie De Clichy
hotels.description: Breakfast and unlimited WIFI included in all rates at the ibis Styles Paris Mairie de Clichy. This hotel is ideal for cultural and business trips alike. Located 55 yards (50 m) from the Mairie de Clichy stop on metro line 13, which will get you to the cen ter of Paris in 10 minutes. With an array of restaurants and stores close to the hotel, make the most of everything Paris has to offer, with peace and quiet too.

hotels.name: ibis Aulnay Paris Nord Expo
hotels.description: The ibis Aulnay Paris Nord Expo hotel is located 10 minutes from the Villepinte and Le Bourget exhibition parks for annual trade fairs, competitions, political conventions and air shows. Also nearby: Paris-Nord 2 and Garonor business centers, Circuit Carole and Roissy-CDG airport. The main roads take you to Stade de France, the heart of Paris, Parc Astérix (20 min) and Parc Robert Ballanger (2 min).

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Mairie de Montreuil
hotels.description: Step into a world inspired by Georges Méliès! Our stylish hotel in Montreuil welcomes guests to modern, air-conditioned rooms with comfortable bedding and fully equipped bathrooms. Enjoy breakfast in the Zen garden or relax in the bar. Located right next to metro line 9, close to shops, bars, theaters and cinemas, experience a creative and cinematic escape just a stone's throw from Paris.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Velizy
hotels.description: At ibis Styles Paris Vélizy, every stays embodies creativity, community and accessibility. Inspired by aeronautics, the hotel blends modern design with an airy feel. Our inviting rooms and lobby capture the spirit of travel, featuring comforts such as a hairdryer, shower gel, plush towels and a water carafe. Near the business district, it is an ideal stopover for productivity, relaxation and inspiration.

hotels.name: Mercure Versailles Paris Ouest
hotels.description: 3 miles from Versailles, close to west Paris, 9 miles from the Eiffel Tower and 16 miles from Orly Airport, the 4-star Mercure Versailles Paris Ouest offers comfortable air-conditioned rooms. Work in peace and quiet in an elegant and welcoming atmosphere with a Napoléon theme, while benefiting from all the necessary equipment. The hotel offers quality services to organize your seminars or family stays.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge
hotels.description: Ideal for a stay in Paris, the Adagio Paris Montrouge enjoys a convenient location, well served by public transport, near shopping streets. Situated just 1.6 miles (2.5 km) from Porte de Versailles Exhibition Center, this 4-star aparthotel offers 132 contemporary and practical studios and one-bedroom apartments with an air cooling system. The aparthotel is 15 minutes from Orly Airport and offers parking.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Malakoff Châtillon
hotels.description: This aparthotel is ideal for business stays as well as exploring Paris, with 84 studios including equipped kitchen and lounge with flat-screen TV and free WIFI. There are good public transport connections, with downtown Paris and Paris Expo Porte de Versailles just 15 minutes away. The hotel also offers a shop, coworking area, fitness center and indoor parking.

hotels.name: Hôtel Mercure Paris Malakoff Parc des Expositions
hotels.description: A change of scenery on the outskirts of Paris. Near Montparnasse train station, Roland-Garros and Parc des Princes, our hotel is ideally located for business and leisure stays. Accessible by metro lines 4 and 13, it also has a private parking garage. Our 52-room hotel, renovated in a trendy style on the theme of electricity, will surprise you with its vibrant and dazzling lighting and ambience.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Hippodrome de Vincennes
hotels.description: Renovated in 2024, our contemporary lifestyle hotel welcomes you to the heart of Joinville-le-Pont. With a prime location between nature and the buzz of the city, the hotel gives you easy access to central Paris, the eastern business districts and Accor Arena in Bercy for concerts and shows.

hotels.name: Novotel Suites Paris Issy les Moulineaux
hotels.description: 4-star Novotel Suites Paris Issy les Moulineaux is in the heart of the business district, near Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, the headquarters of major international companies as well as public transport taking you quickly to central Paris. Our spacious 323 sq.ft. suites offer a very comfortable space for short, medium or long stays. Discover our Boutique Gourmande on the ground floor, open 24 hours.

hotels.name: Nest Hotel Paris la Défense - MGallery Collection
hotels.description: NEST Paris La Défense is a 5-star hotel in the MGallery Collection. Be immersed in a cosy and relaxing atmosphere with delicate materials and shimmering colors. Its unexpected, warm and lively combinations offer an intimate ambiance in the heart of La Défense. Below the glass roof bathing it in natural daylight, enjoy tasty dishes with carefully selected seasonal produce at O'Mazette restaurant.

hotels.name: Hotel Mercure Paris Suresnes Longchamp

hotels.name: Hotel Mercure Paris Saint-Ouen
hotels.description: Discover the delights of La Petite Couronne at the Mercure Paris Saint-Ouen. hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Boulogne Marcel Sembat

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Saint Denis Plaine

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Vanves Porte de Versailles

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Quai d'Ivry Aparthotel

hotels.name: ibis Clamart Paris Vélizy
hotels.description: Whether it is a business trip or discovering Paris and its surroundings, the Ibis Clamart Paris Velizy is the perfect stopover. hotels.name: Ibis Styles Paris Gennevilliers

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Porte de Charenton Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Porte de Charenton is in the south-east of Paris, near the Place de la Nation and Bois de Vincennes, with 134 fully furnished, user-friendly apartments from studios to 2-room suites. There is easy access to public transport, especially the 2 metro stations a few yards away, and to the beltway. Set in a quiet residential area, it is perfect for business guests and families.

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Clamart Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Clamart is ideal for all guests, and close to business districts, shopping streets, autoroutes and attractions such as the Bois de Clamart. hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte de Montreuil

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris St-Denis Pleyel
hotels.description: Welcome to the ibis Styles Paris Saint-Denis Pleyel hotel! Looking for a getaway that combines creativity and comfort? You've come to the right place! hotels.name: Mama Shelter Paris La Défense
hotels.description: Between La Défense, the Champs-Élysées and Paris La Défense Arena, Mama Shelter La Défense combines bold design, comfort and conviviality. hotels.name: Hôtel Mercure Paris Ouest Saint Germain

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Maisons-Alfort Aparthotel

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Saint-Denis Pleyel Aparthotel

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Porte de Versailles

hotels.name: Adagio Access Paris Clichy Aparthotel
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Paris Clichy is ideal for business or leisure, in a thriving city with plenty of shops and local color. hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Val de Fontenay

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Roissy-CDG

hotels.name: ibis Styles Paris Ivry Confluence
hotels.description: On the doorstep of Paris, ibis Styles Paris Ivry Confluence offers the comfort of a 3-star hotel with a 24-hour reception and everything you need for a smooth stay, whether you're travelling for business or leisure. From the reception area to the 111 Scandinavian-design rooms, and from the bar to the pleasant indoor patio, the hotel has been designed like a large, warm and welcoming home where everyone can feel at home.

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte d'Italie West

hotels.name: JO&JOE Paris Gentilly

hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte de Pantin
hotels.description: Close to Parc de la Villette and Zenith de Paris, the ibis budget Paris Porte de Pantin has rooms for 1 to 5 people that will meet all your needs. hotels.name: ibis budget Paris Porte de Montmartre

For an affordable price, you can enjoy a break in a modern room with unlimited breakfast, 24-hour reception, free WIFI and a paying undercover car park.

hotels.name: Domaine Reine Margot Paris - Issy - MGallery Collection
hotels.description: Experience a luxurious stay near West Paris at this elegant hotel overlooking Issy-les-Moulineaux. Le Domaine de la Reine Margot - MGallery: a peaceful retreat blending nature and wellness. The garden offers a spectacular view of the city. With a hammam, sauna and pool, the spa offers total relaxation and a chance to unwind. Enjoy chic, rustic dishes at the restaurant, cocktails in the lounge or rums at the speakeasy bar then relax in your room or suite decorated by Jean-Michel Wilmotte.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Puteaux Paris La Defense
hotels.description: The 3-star ibis Styles Puteaux Paris La Defense hotel is ideally located near the business district of La Defense and on the outskirts of Paris. Perfect for business, weekends or family stays, it has modern rooms for up to 4 people. In a quiet eco-district with shops and green spaces, it offers free WIFI, breakfast included and quick access to transport, Paris monuments and Plenitude Arena.

hotels.name: Ibis Styles Bezons Paris La Défense
hotels.description: At the gates of the capital, the ibis Styles Bezons Paris La Defense hotel bridges the Val-d Oise and business districts of Paris. hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Sud Villejuif

hotels.name: ibis Styles Colombes Paris Ouest

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Nanterre La Défense
hotels.description: The Adagio Access Nanterre La Défense enjoys a prime location with quick access to La Défense and central Paris. hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Ivry Confluence

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Massy Gare TGV

hotels.name: ibis Styles Poissy Paris

hotels.name: ibis Styles Antony Paris Sud

Access to central Paris via tram T7 and metro line 14.

hotels.name: Ibis styles Sceaux Paris South

Air-conditioned rooms, breakfast included and free WiFi: everything is designed for a carefree stay. Whether you're here as a couple, with family or on business, experience Sceaux differently, with a Parisian touch!

hotels.name: ibis budget Meudon Paris Ouest

hotels.name: ibis budget Chatillon Paris Ouest

hotels.name: Ibis Styles Evry Lisses Paris Sud

hotels.name: The Savoy - A Fairmont Hotel

From decadent Art Deco designs to elegant Edwardian flourishes, each of the 263 rooms and suites, many with unrivalled river views, offers a glamorous backdrop for an authentically London stay.

hotels.name: ibis London Canning Town

Whether for business or leisure, expect trendsetting décor, top-notch service, and a vibrant atmosphere-your perfect London stay starts here!

hotels.name: Sofitel London St James

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio London City East

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio London Stratford

So whether you are here to take in a show at the O2, shop til you drop at Westfield or take care of business at Canary Wharf, we have got you covered for a great stay.

hotels.name: ibis Styles London Southwark - near Borough Market
hotels.description: Equipped with our very own stylish bar, our affordable London hotel is home to 154 spacious, creatively decorated bedrooms including eight modern suites for larger groups. Wake up to an unlimited, continental all-inclusive breakfast spread and indulge in a typically laid-back approach to checking out - you do not need to leave us until noon.

hotels.name: Pullman London St Pancras
hotels.description: The Pullman London St Pancras hotel is ideally located just a few minutes walk from three of the city's major railway station, Kings Cross, Euston and St Pancras International. hotels.name: Mercure London Bankside
hotels.description: Mercure London Bankside proudly stands as the flagship Mercure hotel within the cultural heart of London, Bankside. Upon entering the hotel. enjoy the homely atmosphere or why not try our French hospitality in Bistro Mirlot offering authentic French gastronomy and wines.

hotels.description: ibis London Earls Court is a 12-storey three-star hotel with breathtaking views of the London skyline. hotels.name: Novotel London Tower Bridge
hotels.description: The Novotel London Tower Bridge is a 4-star hotel at the heart of the British capital, just metres from the world-famous Tower Bridge and the Tower of London. With London landmarks within walking distance and sitting in the shadow of its famous skyline, visitors to London will struggle to find a location better than this. On the doorstep of the City and a couple of stops from Canary Wharf, those visiting on business will love the location and can also take advantage of our excellent onsite facilities.

hotels.name: Mercure London Earls Court
hotels.description: The Mercure London Earls Court is nestled within the leafy districts of Fulham and Chelsea. Superb for business, pleasure and bleisure, the hotel is very close to Old Brompton Road, which leads onto The Museums Science, History, Victoria and Albert, and Harrods. Large pillar free ballroom and bespoke F and B outlets.

hotels.name: TRIBE London Canary Wharf
hotels.description: Whatever brings you to the vibrant British capital, TRIBE London Canary Wharf hotel is your dynamic base for business, leisure and everything in between. Our pet-friendly 4-star London hotel is set amid green spaces near the River Thames, yet minutes from major event venues and the city centre. Discover functional, design-driven rooms featuring luxury bedding and high-speed Wi-Fi, and join us at our Social Hub, a laid-back coworking space in Canary Wharf ideal for important meetings and hanging out alike.

hotels.name: ibis London Blackfriars
hotels.description: Right on the doorsteps of some of the worlds most famous sights and attractions, ibis London Blackfriars promises comfort and convenience in abundance. Whether you are in the capital for some culture on the Southbank and a ride on the Eye, or for a business meeting over in the City, we are perfectly located in the heart of London. Nearby you will enjoy some of Londons best markets, independent stores and live music venues, while crowd pleasers like St Pauls Cathedral and Tate Modern are within easy reach.

hotels.name: Novotel London Blackfriars
hotels.description: Novotel London Blackfriars is ideally located on the South Bank near Southwark Tube Station, offering easy access to London landmarks like the O2 (10 mins), Wembley (45 mins), St Paul's Cathedral, Tate Modern, and the London Eye (15-min walk). With Waterloo and Blackfriars Stations nearby for trips to Windsor or Greenwich, it's perfect for business or leisure. Relax in the pool, saunarium, bar, or restaurant, and enjoy a restful night in a cozy queen-size bed.

hotels.name: ibis London Shepherds Bush - Hammersmith
hotels.description: Secure yourself spotless accommodation and an unbeatable city location, ibis London Shepherds Bush positions you within a stone throw of local attractions and handy transport links. And with a hearty breakfast spread each morning, free fibre Wi-Fi throughout, a modern, airy bar and restaurant, efficient tour-booking service, and plush Sweet Beds in every room, we have got you more than covered for the most relaxing, restorative London stay.

hotels.name: Sofitel London Heathrow
hotels.description: Touch down in to London at Sofitel London Heathrow, the only hotel with direct access to Heathrow Terminal 5 via a 5 minutes covered walk way. Our award-winning hotel features 605 luxurious bedrooms and suites with modern amenities and the largest ballroom in Heathrow, catering up to 1300 people. Indulge into diverse dining options including our 2 AA Rosette Restaurants where guests can experience rich global flavours.

hotels.name: ibis London Elstree Borehamwood
hotels.description: Featuring super-comfortable Sweet Beds in every room, ibis London Elstree Borehamwood ensures a restful stay. hotels.name: Novotel London Bridge

hotels.name: Novotel London Wembley

hotels.name: ibis Styles London Gloucester Road

hotels.name: Mercure London Hyde Park Hotel
hotels.description: Immerse yourself in the refined comfort of Mercure London Hyde Park, where historic elegance and contemporary convenience converge. Relish the ease of flexible bookings and savor the tranquility of your London retreat. Discover your urban sanctuary with us.

hotels.name: Novotel London Canary Wharf
hotels.description: Novotel London Canary Wharf is a modern 39-storey hotel located in Canary Wharf, Londons renowned financial district. Whether visiting for work or leisure, guests can enjoy a comfortable and well-connected stay with a wide range of amenities.

hotels.name: Novotel London Paddington
hotels.description: Discover Novotel London Paddington, featuring newly refurbished rooms, an indoor pool, fitness centre and 11 versatile meeting rooms. Enjoy breakfast with daily-changing selections and all-day dining at No.3 Restaurant & Bar, including innovative plant-forward dishes. Ideally located near Paddington Station, Hyde Park and the Elizabeth Line, the hotel is the perfect base for business and leisure travellers seeking comfort, convenience and contemporary style.

hotels.name: ibis London City - Shoreditch
hotels.description: Just a 15-minute stroll from the banks of the Thames, a stay at Ibis London City - Shoreditch promises convenience as well as comfort. You will fall in love with the amazing local food markets, offering cuisine from around the world, independent stores and live music venues that Shoreditch has to offer.

hotels.name: ibis London Greenwich
hotels.description: Ibis London Greenwich is a modern hotel in the heart of historic Greenwich, ideal for both leisure and business travelers. Its recently refurbished social lobby and bar serve as a lively hub where guests can unwind and relax. The hotel features 38 newly upgraded rooms with free Wi-Fi and contemporary amenities. hotels.name: Novotel London Greenwich

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio London Sutton Point
hotels.description: The Adagio London Sutton Point is ideally located just a few minutes walk from Sutton station and Sutton High Street, so guests can enjoy the bustling area or travel to London in just 30 minutes. hotels.name: ibis London Wembley
hotels.description: Ibis London Wembley is a modern hotel situated in the heart of Wembley, one of London's most vibrant areas. It offers convenient access to some of the city's major attractions, including the iconic Wembley Stadium and OVO Arena, making it an ideal choice for sports enthusiasts, concert-goers, and tourists alike. The hotel offers a range of comfortable, well-appointed rooms with modern decor. Book your stay at Ibis London Wembley and be at the heart of the action from football games to concerts and NFL!
hotels.street: South Way, Wembley, Sat Nav Use HA9 0HB

hotels.name: Delano London
hotels.description: Behind a stately Victorian facade overlooking Kensington Gardens, Delano arrives with the enchanting spirit of the Miami icon and the elegance of London. Inside, signature design and cultural energy flow through 67 spacious rooms and suites, Mediterranean dining at Lana Lusa, and the legendary Rose Bar. Curated regional art and The Source by Delano, a refined yet joyful spa, fitness and wellness offering, complete a destination that is shaped by the city and unmistakably Delano.

hotels.name: The Hoxton Southwark
hotels.description: The hotel is located in the Southwark borough of London, a short walk from The Shard, Tate Modern, Borough Market and Shakespeare's Globe. 1 minute walk to Southwark Station for the Jubilee line (8 minutes direct to the West End, 20 minutes direct to the O2 arena) and a 10 minute walk to Waterloo Station. Albie: All-day dining and café/bar.  Seabird: rooftop bar and restaurant with sweeping skyline views of London.  24-hour, 12th floor guest gym with views over London.

hotels.name: Hyde London City
hotels.description: Set moments from St Paul's Cathedral, Hyde London City blends bohemian spirit with the energy of London. Housed in a beautifully restored historic building, the hotel features thoughtfully designed rooms offering a calm retreat from the city buzz. At its heart is Leydi, serving bold modern Turkish flavours with open-fire cooking, vibrant sharing plates and cocktails that carry the evening long after dinner

hotels.name: Sanderson London, a Morgans Originals hotel
hotels.description: Sanderson London, a Morgans Originals hotel, in the heart of the West End, offers a retreat from the bustle of the city into a world of fantasy. The landmarked 1950s building has been transformed by Philippe Starck into a surreal Cocteau like dream world, epitomising a new luxury that is smart, pared down and tempered with a healthy dose of wit and irony. With rooms designed by designer Tim Andreas of Banjo, the rooms maintain their sense of whimsy while offering state of the art details and luxurious touches at every turn.

hotels.name: St Martins Lane London, a Morgans Originals hotel
hotels.description: Viewed through the looking glass of classic Britain with a dash of eccentricity, St Martins Lane is situated in the bustling theatre district in Covent Garden. Elegant and edgy meets decadent in our social spaces with gold teeth seating, life sized chess pieces, and a boutique tea facade hiding away something special.

hotels.name: Old Thorns Golf Resort and Spa Hampshire by Accor
hotels.description: Old Thorns Hotel is set in 400 acres of picturesque Hampshire countryside that offers you a unique experience all in one place. With bedrooms, residences and penthouses, golf course, meeting and events spaces, restaurants, health club and spa, you can get to us easily from London and the South. Old Thorns is the ideal destination for you to enjoy a night away, staycation, wedding, event, golf break, conference and much more.

hotels.name: Aparthotel Adagio London Brentford
hotels.description: Perfect for a business trip as well as for your leisure stay, the Adagio London Brentford benefits from an ideal location. The aparthotel is situated close to London city centre and all the point of interest with direct transportation. London Heathrow air port is also at only 15 min by car. This property offers 100 apartments with a fully equipped kitchen, a large balcony, flat screen TV and free wifi access. For even more comfort, the aparthotel provides a fitness centre and an indoor private parking.
hotels.street: Kew Eye Tower, Ealing Road, Brentford

hotels.name: ibis London Sutton Point
hotels.description: The ibis London Sutton Point is perfectly located in the heart of Sutton, Surrey. Designed with comfort and enjoyment at its heart, guests can enjoy new Plaza concept bedrooms, which have been considerately designed by FGMF architects. With everything you need to enjoy a comfortable stay, you are sure to feel at home from the moment you arrive. Guests are also welcome to relax in Charlie s Corner, a cosy yet sophisticated spot perfect for enjoying a morning coffee or craft beer and music in the evening.
hotels.street: 8 Sutton Plaza, Sutton Ct Road, Sutton

hotels.name: ibis London Excel Docklands
hotels.description: The ibis London ExCel Docklands boasts a prime waterside location, making it an ideal choice for business and leisure stays in the city. London Docklands sits at the heart of Southeast London, close to the O2 Arena and Canary Wharf. Enjoy plenty of transport links and access to Central London when you choose this comfortable and convenient ibis hotel. Hungry. Visit local bars and restaurants, pop into the city centre, or head to our on-site spot for international food and drinks served fresh every day.

hotels.name: ibis London Thurrock M25
hotels.description: With our economy room rates, our modern, affordable hotel offers so much more than just the basics. From free fibre Wi-Fi to on-site parking, a hearty hot breakfast to eat in, we have kept our prices low while making sure all boxes are ticked. As an added bonus, our laid-back, stylish bar and restaurant offers relaxing spots for enjoying dinners . And if you need a hand with anything. The friendly team at our affordable hotel is always happy to help

hotels.name: Mercure London Paddington Hotel
hotels.description: The 4-star Mercure London Paddington hotel blends contemporary design with the convenience of being in central London. Located next to Paddington station, this stylish hotel offers state-of-the-art facilities to help make your stay a welcome one. Its serene setting offers a contrast to the hustle and bustle of the city, with each room providing guests with the comforts of home and more. The hotel comes equipped with a 24-hour gym, while the on-site restaurant serves food and drinks all day.

hotels.name: Novotel London Excel
hotels.description: The Novotel London ExCel is the closest hotel to the ExCel Exhibition Centre, a perfect choice for making the most of a visit to the venue. Whether you're staying in London for business or leisure, the hotel is a comfortable and convenient Southeastern base. The O2 Arena and Canary Wharf are nearby, while plenty of transport links make getting around a breeze. Explore the local area or enjoy beautiful views of Victoria Dock from the terrace at Upper Deck, our casual restaurant and bar.

hotels.name: ibis London Barking
hotels.description: Whether you're exploring the capital, taking care of business at Canary Wharf, heading for adventure from London City Airport or indulging in serious retail therapy at Westfield Stratford, ibis London Barking offers easy access to all of it. Home to 86 inviting guest bedrooms (complete with en suite power showers, 43' flat screen TV's and tea & coffee facilities), our affordable London hotel puts on a very good value hot & cold breakfast spread each morning, setting you up for even the busiest of days.

hotels.name: ibis London Stratford
hotels.description: ibis London Stratford positions you perfectly for your London getaway and, from check-in to check-out, we have got your every need covered. Our bar will keep you refreshed from morning to midnight, and our on-site restaurant offers a relaxing spot to enjoy a lazy lunch or an indulgent evening meal. So whether you are here to take in a show at the O2, shop til you drop at Westfield or take care of business at Canary Wharf, we have got you covered for a great stay.

hotels.name: Novotel London West
hotels.description: The Novotel London West is an ideal hotel for business or leisure stays. From family city breaks to business trips in London, comfortable rooms and flexible meeting spaces make this Hammersmith hotel the perfect base.

hotels.name: ibis London Docklands Canary Wharf
hotels.description: ibis London Docklands Canary Wharf is the perfect place whether you are travelling for business or leisure. With our 87 modern guest bedrooms it is perfectly located for exploring and visiting the financial and historical district of Canary Wharf and has very good transport links to visit the sights around London. Having the Docklands Light Railway, ( Blackwall DLR Station ) on our doorstep it makes a trip to the ExCel Congress and Convention Centre or the O2 Arena for concerts and other events very easy.

hotels.name: ibis budget London Whitechapel - Brick Lane
hotels.description: Looking for an affordable hotel in central London? Ibis Budget London Whitechapel offers stylish, budget accommodation just minutes from Whitechapel and Aldgate Underground stations. With easy access to central London and top East London attractions, its an ideal base for city breaks and business trips. Enjoy a fresh continental breakfast, 24 hours snacks, and explore nearby hotspots like Brick Lane and Spitalfields Market-well known for street food, art, shopping, and vintage markets.

hotels.name: ibis budget London Barking
hotels.description: Home to 130 guest bedrooms with invigorating en suite power showers, our affordable Barking hotel sets you up with everything you need under one roof. Guests benefit from a choice of well-appointed triple, double and twin bedrooms, a friendly service around the clock, spotless attention to detail and nearby conveniences including a Tesco Superstore right next door. Great for families, with 24 hours hot food options and secure on-site parking available.

hotels.name: Sofitel London Gatwick
hotels.description: Travel stress-free at Sofitel London Gatwick with direct corridor access straight from the hotel lobby to Gatwicks North Terminal. Savour culinary delights as you choose from 4 delicious restaurants and refreshing hot buffet breakfast is served daily in Le petit reveur.  Club Millesime rooms boast runway views and access to the exclusive Club Lounge with all-inclusive bites and drinks.  The Park and Fly package offers stress-free travel with the ability to park, stay, travel and return home in style.

hotels.name: Novotel London Stansted Airport
hotels.description: Conveniently located by London Stansted Airport, this stylish 4-star full service hotel is a short shuttle ride from the main terminal building.  Near junction 8 of the M11, the hotel has over 500 parking spaces. There are 250 guest rooms, 8 meeting rooms, fitness gym, bar, restaurant and garden with patio area.

hotels.name: Novotel London Brentford
hotels.description: Novotel London Brentford is a welcoming four-star hotel in Brentford near Kew Gardens and Gunnersbury Park. Blending comfort and connectivity, flexibility and functionality, this family-friendly hotel in London has spacious modern rooms that are ideal for work colleagues and families. Swim in the pool, work out in the gym, and then enjoy fine flavours in Gourmet Restaurant & Bar. Business travellers can book bespoke event spaces, while leisure guests can explore local attractions like Twickenham Stadium.

hotels.name: ibis London Heathrow Airport
hotels.description: ibis London Heathrow Airport puts you just minutes from Terminals 2 & 3 - the perfect spot for a layover, business trip or holiday. Settle in for a great night's sleep in one of our 356 comfortable rooms, complete with Sweet Beds. Fuel up with our hot & cold buffet breakfast, or enjoy lunch and dinner from our à la carte menu. Fancy a drink? Head to the bar or grab a snack from our self-service shop. Free Wi-Fi keeps you connected, and our on-site parking (with EV chargers) makes travel easy.

hotels.name: ibis London Luton Airport
hotels.description: The ibis London Luton Airport is ideally located just a few minutes walk from Luton Airport. Complete with cosy rooms, that are equipped will all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay. You are guaranteed, a stylish welcome at our pet-friendly hotel. The hotel restaurant and bar, serves a range of delicious cuisines, accompanied with your favourite drinks. All in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere. There is also a 24-hour menu if you are feeling peckish outside regular meal times.

hotels.name: greet London Harlow
hotels.description: greet London Harlow is perfectly positioned for both business and leisure travellers. Just 11 miles, around a 16-minute drive from Stansted Airport, the hotel offers easy access via the nearby M11 and convenient on-site parking. Direct rail links to Central London make it an ideal base for weekend city breaks. We can not wait to greet you.

hotels.name: ibis Styles London Ealing
hotels.description: A very warm welcome to ibis Styles London Ealing, ideally located just a short 6-minute walk from Ealing Broadway Station and the Elizabeth Line. Step into our quirky, cinema-themed hotel, where unique props and vintage posters create  a playful  and  inspiring atmosphere. After  a  day  of  exploring  or working, unwind in our stylish  hotel bar with a refreshing  drink , the  perfect way to  relax and end  your day in comfort and style. We  look  forward  to making  your  stay memorable  and  enjoyable.

hotels.name: ibis Styles London Gatwick Airport
hotels.description: The transformed ibis Styles London Gatwick Airport hotel is just six minutes drive from Gatwick Airport. The journey is part of the adventure, so start yours in style at this upbeat hotel with a bustling yet welcoming bar and lobby, serving international cuisine. Practicality and design go hand in hand in the triple glazed, air conditioned bedrooms. Include the hotel meeting space and gym, and you have got all you need to get your travel plans off to a flying start.

hotels.name: ibis Styles London Heathrow Airport
hotels.description: Take to the sky well fed, well rested and ready for anything. Our Hot English Buffet Breakfast is available at a supplement of £14 per person per night. The on-site restaurant serves snacks all day and à la carte treats in the evening, plus our cosy, welcoming bar is a great place to kick back and contemplate the adventure ahead. We've got your every need covered throughout your stay, including free fibre Wi-Fi, a 24hr reception service. Airside Parking as well as EV charging now available please ask.

hotels.name: ibis budget London Heathrow Central
hotels.description: ibis budget London Heathrow Central hotel is ideal for flights, family time and fun in London. Our hotel near Heathrow Airport is 10 minutes' drive from Terminals 2 and 3, and we have paid parking on site. The Hotel Hoppa shuttle also stops here. Unwind in our restaurant or our colourful bar, and catch up using free Wi-Fi. After a peaceful sleep in one of our soundproof rooms, the hot English breakfast buffet will set you up for flight or a day of sightseeing at Windsor Castle or in central London.

Choose from triple, double or twin rooms to suit you, chill out in our well-decorated lobby area and stay connected while you are away from home with free Wi-Fi throughout the building. Only card payment accepted at the property. NO CASH. Just 3 stops to Heathrow Airport Terminals.

The ove rall design will take visitors through the evolving periods of Tokyo from the past to the future with the concept of "Tokyo Eclectic". The design elements highlight the delicacy of tradition and handicraft and the history of the Haneda neighbourhood.

hotels.name: Fairmont Tokyo
hotels.description:
YOUR MOMENTS BECOME LEGACY
Embark on a journey of discovery at Fairmont Tokyo, where the city's energy meets the bay's serenity. Indulge in curated experiences, scenic accommodations, and tranquil spa moments. With 217 rooms and suites, an infinity pool, and five dining venues, every detail is crafted to create special memories. Celebrate in our stunning event spaces, perfect for weddings and gatherings, or enjoy privacy at the Fairmont Gold lounge. Experience a legacy of excellence

hotels.name: Pullman Tokyo Tamachi
hotels.description: Whether visiting for business or pleasure, Pullman Tokyo Tamachi has everything a discerning traveler could wish for when visiting this iconic metropolis. Located in the Tamachi area of the city, getting around is easy, with transport links mere minutes from the hotel. The design of the Pullman in Tamachi, Tokyo, is based on a modern fusion of Japanese art and culture and makes the perfect base for both short and long-term visitors. Experience Tokyo like never before when staying at Pullman Tokyo hotel.

hotels.name: Mercure Tokyo Hibiya
hotels.description: Mercure Tokyo Hibiya is an ideal base for exploring Tokyo, located adjacent to the glamorous Ginza district while also offering the vibrant, local atmosphere to Shimbashi, the hub for multiple rail networks, providing convenient access from the airport to major tourist attractions, which will allow you to freely enjoy Tokyo's diverse charms. The hotel features facilities to accommodate various types of stays, from business to leisure.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Tokyo Ginza East
hotels.description: 【Newly Renovated: June 2026】ibis Styles Tokyo Ginza East is a modern 3-star hotel in Ginza, offering stylish but affordable accommodation just steps from Ginza's main shopping area. Freshly renovated, our welcoming rooms and Ginza's only rooftop Open Air Bath place us on par with the preferred hotels in Ginza. If you're looking for a place to stay in Ginza, ibis Styles Tokyo Ginza East is ideal for those wishing to explore Tokyo and beyond, providing a central location surrounded by a peaceful atmosphere.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Tokyo Ginza
hotels.description: ibis Styles Tokyo Ginza is conveniently located in Tokyo's Shopping haven, Ginza. The finest attractions of Ginza are within walking distance from the hotel including Ginza Dori, Kabuki Theatre and the Imperial Palace. Ginza subway station, nearest to the hotel, provides access to all must-see destinations in Tokyo. The hotel's proximity to the Tokyo International Forum, and other major venues make the hotel an obvious choice for exhibitors and business travelers.

hotels.name: ibis Styles Tokyo Bay
hotels.description: The 216 guest room, design is inspired by seaport, ibis Styles Tokyo Bay is conveniently located near a world famous theme park and just a stone's throw away from Central Tokyo. Base yourself at this fashionable hotel, designed for both the young and the young at heart. Enjoy a well-balanced breakfast at the Streats restaurant, where the aroma of freshly baked croissants and a wide variety of local and worldwide favorites will give you just the right jolt to have a remarkable day.
